jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Finance Project Coordinator

**Location:** Hybrid (Culver City)

**Department:** Finance

**Reports to:** Director of Finance

**About the job**

* LA based preferred, able to work a hybrid schedule with office hours in Culver City, CA.
* Applications must include a portfolio link, including password if applicable, for consideration

 **Infinity Marketing Team**


A fully integrated and award winning marketing, event, and promotion agency, Infinity Marketing Team (IMT) creates and executes campaigns designed specifically for each of our clients’ brand objectives. With unparalleled expertise in event executions, exhibit environments, mobile marketing tours, digital marketing, event furnishings, and brand marketing strategies, IMT offers numerous means for our clients to achieve premium outcomes. We Create. We Implement. We Show Results!


From spectacular filmed and streamed event productions to jaw\-dropping international conferences and tradeshow displays to globally recognized mobile marketing tours and influencer crossovers, IMT uses an infinite realm of methods to assist companies in strengthening their brands and enhancing their voices in the marketplace. In over 10,000 event marketing campaigns, IMT maintains our guiding belief \- there are no boundaries and there are no limits.

**About the Role**


The Finance Project Coordinator is responsible for financial management of experiential marketing projects including oversight of revenue recognition, financial reporting, forecasting, and process compliance. The Project Finance Coordinator will function as the Business liaison on larger or more complex projects or clients including contract and pricing negotiations (with oversight).

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Client Servicing**

* Coordinate data collection for client audits
* Communicate with internal project teams regarding budgets, billing, and accounts receivable issues
* Maintain catalog of required client reporting and ensure timely completion

**Financial Management and Planning**

* Support project teams in building and entering client budgets, responding to RFP’s and developing budgets (with oversight)
* Ensure that projects are managed in accordance with contracts; create summary sheets for account and project teams
* Ensure written client agreements are obtained (via contract, letter of agreement, signed SOW, etc.) for all work and are appropriately archived and classified. Liaise with Contract Specialists and Legal.
* Assist project teams with monthly project budget to actual tracking and other required client reporting
* Review and approve scopes and staffing plans; escalate issues to finance lead as appropriate.
* Review monthly fee and expense details. Analyze accuracy and explain significant variances to budget or forecast
* Prepare management reports and identify and communicate areas of concern and suggested improvements to project staff and management (e.g., client profitability, utilization, over/under service, missing time, revenue risk and staffing plans)
* Facilitate monthly billing liaison between project team and finance/accounting department and review billing reports
* Review time and expense write\-offs and unbilled WIP
* Work with project team to minimize risk exposure surrounding accounts receivables and credit requirements of clients
* Accountable for timely and valuable AR collection status commentary and liaison with Accounts Receivable
* Supervise project set up process for project team and perform finance liaison role for larger or more complex projects.
* Drive profitability by working with accounts, production, and management
* Review staffing utilization, realization, and capacity and proactively communicate meaningful observations with leaders
* Ensure compliance with company financial policies (e.g., revenue recognition, project requisitions, time entry, travel and expense, credit, billing, accounts payable, new business)
* Ad hoc requests and projects

**Qualifications**

* The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor’s Degree in Finance or Accounting with two years of Finance or Accounting experience preferred.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills.

**Preferred Knowledge And Skills**

* The ideal candidate will have excellent written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills, be client service oriented and foster positive working relationships.
* Is well organized with strong time management skills and attention to detail, follows through on multiple projects and juggle conflicting priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* The candidate will also possess strong financial analysis and management skills, good business acumen, ability to articulate financial concerns in layman’s terms, and be a self\-starter and initiative taker.
* Advanced knowledge of financial systems.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Paid holidays, PTO, and recovery days
* Opportunities for career growth and creative collaboration
* A culture that values inclusivity, hustle, fun, and innovation

jobs.title: Administrative College & Clinical Education Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE:** Administrative College \& Clinical Education Operations Coordinator

**DEPARTMENT:** College of Health Professions

**LOCATION:** Hybrid \- On\-campus (80% \- 4 days) and Remote (20% \- 1 day)

**FSLA STATUS:** Non\-exempt

**REPORTS TO:** Dean of College of Health Professions

**COMPENSATION:** $27\.50/Hour

**GENERAL PURPOSE OF THE JOB:**

This position is primarily responsible for coordinating day\-to\-day administrative tasks for the College of Health Professions and dedicated to the Dean by performing the following duties.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Coordinator ensures efficient operation for the College of Health Professions by providing administrative and project management support for the college and programs, including clinical operations and contract management support for programs and the Dean. This role will include coordination of activities with other departments or programs, administrative support to faculty and staff, HR related activities, data collection and review, preparation of reports, committee work, student support, updating of web pages and catalog sections, event and meeting coordination, etc. This requires interaction with Evidence in Motion to manage and obtain signatures on affiliation agreements for programs within the College of Health Professions, including certificates of liability. This is an active role, which involves dealing with a wide range of matters, sometimes of a confidential nature and requires attention to detail, organization, interpersonal and communication skills. The coordinator must be able to multitask and prioritize effectively, work with tight deadlines, and learn new systems and procedures rapidly.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Dean Support**

* Manage the calendar of the Dean.
* Support the Dean in the management \& completion of various University processes to agreed deadlines.
* Reports on status of college, departmental and University projects.
* Coordinates meeting requests with internal and external entities.
* Records minutes for meetings conducted by the Dean, Program Dean/Director.
* Works with the Dean/Directors to prepare and track all business transactions pertinent to the college activity including purchase orders (PO), check requests, and Memoranda of Understanding (MOU).
* Completes all clinical education affiliation agreement routing for the College of Health Professions through SCU internal offices for review and signature.
* Enters and manages clinical education agreements within EXXAT database.
* Works directly with the Evidence in Motion Clinical Operations team to manage clinical education processes and agreements.
* Plans, organizes, and coordinates travel arrangements for the Dean.
* Provides support for all program accreditations.
* Assists in the development of the annual budget, monitors college budget expenditures, creates reports as needed.
* Acts as liaison between Dean/Director and faculty, staff, students, University departments, and outside agencies and organizations.
* Coordinates special projects and events as needed.
* Utilizes feedback to improve college processes.

**Faculty Support**

* Ensures faculty data is complete and accurate in all databases and platforms.
* Coordinates and monitors attendance and grade submission to meet university deadlines.
* Supports the directors of clinical education and academic fieldwork coordinators in clinical education agreement management and signature procurement.

**College Support**

* Responsible for the coordination/completion and the quality of the clerical work for the college.
* Performs and coordinates scheduling tasks and support services associated with preparing and making arrangements for and assisting with on\-campus events, meetings, conferences, travel, or other related duties.
* Represents the college at events such as orientation, first day of classes, graduation and other ceremonies, symposia, examination weeks, etc.
* Manage the college academic calendar and communicates key dates through MySCU, Canvas, and the university academic calendar (when indicated).
* Assists in the preparation of status and technical reports and documents (Accreditation, book adoptions, student rosters, etc.).
* Maintains confidential records and files (paper and electronic).
* Monitors and maintains an inventory of durable and non\-durable inventory, supplies, and capital equipment, monitors functionality and expiration dates and plans for equipment replacement.
* Assist with purchasing requirements including obtaining vendor price quotes, requisitions for purchase, initiates and communicates with the purchasing department.
* Monitors for accuracy and updates portions of the academic catalog (Acalog), handbooks, website, MySCU, faculty/staff email lists, and other publications.
* Coordinates curriculum revision projects and ensures accuracy of data in course information systems (Canvas, Curriculog, J1\).
* Assists in managing and updating academic platforms and databases such as Canvas, J1, Teams, MySCU, ExamSoft, Interfolio, Curriculog, Electronic Student Academic Records, and program specific databases.
* Monitors and guides the completion of college projects and assignments.
* Manage the college academic calendar and communicates key dates through MySCU, Canvas, and the university academic calendar (when indicated).
* Coordinates the development of annual and term program and examination schedules, faculty and room assignments, and inputs data into schedule management system (Coursedog).
* Informs faculty, staff, and students of changes in the schedule; manages all processes related to the changes in courses offered in a term.
* Provides information related to university and college policies, processes, and deadlines, and directs individuals to sources of additional information.
* Maintains college book lists and coordinates updates through the curriculum management system
* (Curriculog), compliance reports, and communication with the LRC.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:

Now the largest fully independent commercial real estate firm in the Western U.S., Kidder Mathews has over 900 professionals across 19 offices in Washington, Oregon, California, Nevada, and Arizona. The firm averages $9 billion in transaction volume, manages more than 54 million square feet of space, and conducts 2,700 appraisal, consulting, and cost segregation assignments annually.

The Marketing Coordinator works as part of a team that supports the firm's commercial real estate brokers with their daily graphics projects, property marketing, maps and aerial imagery, research, and administrative tasks. They interact closely with senior marketing coordinators and collaborate with other Kidder Mathews offices and departments. At BuildOps, we're building a groundbreaking software solution, purpose\-built to support today's commercial contractors. From helping our customers to manage their service all the way to project management, we're breaking the mold and building a team that invests in our mission statement. We love driven, self\-motivated folks experienced in tech start\-ups and thrive in fast\-paced environments. Could you be our next hire?



As our Named Commercial Customer Success Manager, you will join a well\-funded, fast\-growing technology startup with the unique opportunity to help shape and scale a critical customer segment for the company.



The successful candidate will be responsible for managing a portfolio of commercial customers, driving adoption and utilization of the platform in your accounts, executing defined success playbooks, and proactively identifying and addressing portfolio risk. Our engagement model blends digital\-first and AI\-driven touchpoints with meaningful human intervention, ensuring customers receive the right level of support at the right time. The ideal candidate is someone who works hard, demonstrates strong analytical thinking, and is passionate about driving measurable value and outcomes for their customers.


### **What you'll do:**


* **Customer Engagement:** Build strong relationships with key customer stakeholders through digital first engagement and proactive touchpoints. Manage a healthy portfolio of Commercial accounts, ensuring customers receive maximum value from our platform at every stage of their journey.
* **Product Expert and Educator:** Become a BuildOps product expert and teach customers how to use the platform to its full potential. Learn the BuildOps platform in depth, understand how customers use it across their business workflows, and guide customers through configuration, feature adoption, and process improvements.
* **Workflow Discovery and Technical Enablement:** Translate customer workflows and pain points into clear recommendations. Escalate product gaps or technical issues to Product, Engineering, Support, or Professional Services when appropriate. * **Portfolio Health and Risk Management:** Monitor customer health and usage data across your portfolio to proactively identify risk signals and intervene before issues escalate. Build and execute playbooks to address at risk customers and manage portfolio risk with urgency and precision.
* **Customer Champion and Cross Functional Coordinator:** Serve as a proactive escalation point and tireless customer advocate. Coordinate seamless handoffs across the customer journey with Professional Services, Customer Support, and the Customer Experience team to ensure a consistent, high quality experience at every stage.

Contribute new ideas to commercial playbooks and help drive segment level insights and best practice development to continuously elevate how we serve our commercial customers.

### **What we look for:**


* 1\-2 years of experience in customer success, client success, software implementation, or technical account management.
* B.A. or B.S. degree
* Experience learning and becoming an expert in an operating platform, ERP, or similar type of software platform.

* Highly organized with the ability to manage a portfolio of accounts, prioritize across competing demands, and stay focused on customer and company goals.
* Comfortable operating within defined playbooks and structured processes, with the curiosity and initiative to contribute improvements and iterate on them over time.
* Self\-motivated, driven to succeed, fast learning and ability to thrive in a fast paced, dynamic startup environment
* Prior experience or ability to learn internal tools including Salesforce, Gainsight, Service Cloud, and Jira.

### **Bonus:**

Our platform is powered by the Mindset Graph™, our AI\-driven data engine that processes billions of real\-time contextual, creative, environmental, and historical signals to match every ad with the most receptive audience. The result is advertising that drives meaningful outcomes for advertisers and publishers, and is more relevant for consumers.



We were founded in 2008 and are headquartered in Santa Monica, California, operating in over 19 markets across North America, Europe, Japan, and Australia.



Our principles guide our work every day and are as follows:


* **Customer\-Obsessed:** We're focused on advertising solutions that solve needs and drive success for clients and partners.
* **Make it Happen:** We have a bias for action and take ownership to deliver results.
* **Always Innovate:** We push boundaries with creativity and technology.
* **Foster Belonging:** We ensure colleagues feel included, supported, and empowered to thrive.


To be a part of The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising, please visit www.gumgum.com/careers.


The HR Operations Specialist is a core member of GumGum's People Operations team, responsible for the day\-to\-day execution of benefits administration, immigration support, compensation operations, and recurring People programs.  

  

This role sits between our People Ops coordinators and the specialists who own strategy in each domain, providing the operational execution, data integrity, and process support that keeps the People function running smoothly across benefits, immigration, compensation, and program delivery.  

  

The ideal candidate is an organized, detail\-oriented generalist who is comfortable moving across HR domains rather than specializing in one, and who uses tools like ChatGPT or Claude to work efficiently and accurately.  

  

This role reports to the VP, People \& Culture.



Note: GumGum fosters a flexible work environment, offering GumGummers the ability to work either in\-office or remotely/from home. However, for occasional in\-person collaboration, we kindly ask that this position be located within a 'commutable' distance to our office.


**What You'll Achieve**


* Own day\-to\-day benefits administration and drive the annual open enrollment cycle end to end — enrollments, qualifying life events, invoice reconciliation, and COBRA coordination.
* Partner with the team's immigration point of contact to keep cases and filing deadlines on track, and own I\-9 and E\-Verify execution outright.
* Maintain the compensation data the whole People function runs on: the variable pay index, the job architecture and levelling library, and submissions to our benchmarking partners.
* Build the analysis behind real pay decisions — band placement, compa\-ratio, and offer analytics the team acts on.
* Keep recurring People programs moving on cadence, from the performance review cycle to the annual compensation review to engagement surveys.
* Curate the People programs calendar so cycles land cleanly and never collide.
* Work alongside our People systems owners on data integrity and audits across HR tools like ChartHop.
* Take on cross\-domain special projects as they surface — a generalist seat with genuine range.


**Skills You'll Bring**


* 3\+ years in HR or People Operations, comfortable moving across benefits, immigration, compensation, and program support rather than specializing in one.
* Proven ability to run a defined process independently once trained — processing enrollments, reconciling data, or preparing reports.
* Experience supporting a recurring People program such as open enrollment or a performance cycle as part of a team.
* Hands\-on fluency in an HRIS or payroll system such as ADP Workforce Now.
* A reconciliation instinct: you can put two data sets side by side, like invoices against enrollment records, and spot what doesn't line up.

* Clear written and verbal communication, including fielding employee questions on benefits and process with confidence.
* AI literacy — you use tools like ChatGPT or Claude to draft communications, analyze data, and troubleshoot faster, with real examples to point to.


**What We Offer**



At GumGum, competitive base pay is a part of a total rewards package which also includes benefits, an emphasis on recognition, development, and wellness. The reasonable estimated base pay range for this role is from ***$86,000 \- $106,000*** ***annually.*** The actual amount may be higher or lower. The total rewards package offered also includes an employer\-matched 401(k) retirement plan, and depending on the role, participation in a bonus, commission, or stock incentive program. **Department Overview** The Community Integrated Prevention (CIP) unit within the Prevention Department drives health equity, environmental advocacy, and community education around alcohol, tobacco, and other drugs (ATOD) across the South Bay (SPA 8\) region. Through youth and adult coalition building, policy advocacy, and community outreach, CIP empowers residents to create safer, healthier environments.

**Position Summary** The CIP Outreach Worker supports alcohol and other drug (AOD) education and prevention outreach across the South Bay (SPA 8\) region. * Support the educational development of youth and adult coalition members in collaboration with local and regional prevention partners.
* Assist with conducting comprehensive community assessments across assigned target areas in the South Bay (SPA 8\) region.
* Develop creative educational outreach materials using media advocacy, including social media posts/reels, flyers, virtual training videos, and podcasts.
* Educate, inform, and cultivate awareness around ATOD issues with city, county, and state decision\-makers and city staff.
* Support the implementation of Strategic Prevention Framework (SPF) action plans by engaging local youth and adult volunteers.

Loro Piana is an Italian luxury Maison founded in 1924, known for creating the finest quality textiles, ready\-to\-wear collections, accessories, and bespoke garments. Our dedication to exceptional craftsmanship and use of the world’s finest raw materials positions us a leader in the luxury industry. As an iconic Maison within the LVMH group, we uphold a strong commitment to unparalleled quality and excellence.  



General Purpose of the Position:


We are seeking a Seasonal Operations Specialist to join our team at Loro Piana. The Operations Specialist plays a pivotal role in the overall success of the business by supporting all operational and inventory\-related activities. You will be responsible for managing incoming and outgoing shipments, replenishing products on the sales floor, and organizing inventory to maximize efficiency. You will collaborate with all members of the team to ensure that stockroom conditions align with Loro Piana standards, contributing to seamless store operations.


### **Job responsibilities**

Key Responsibilities


* Optimize inventory flow and streamline operational processes while handling the accurate processing of shipments and transfers.
* Oversee the movement of merchandise from the stockroom to the sales floor and maintain appropriate inventory levels to align with sales potential.
* Conduct cycle counts as per corporate calendar to verify product quantities and report discrepancies in a timely manner. Perform regular audits to verify product conditions.
* Facilitate the implementation of security measures through inspections, audits, and preparing products for display.
* Ensure ongoing inventory organization according to company procedures and establish an optimized warehouse layout for improved accessibility by the sales team.
* Maintain clean, neat, and organized stock rooms with proper labeling to facilitate sales.
* Maintain effective communication with the operations team and external couriers to ensure accurate shipping procedures and timely delivery.
Provide the sales team with detailed updates regarding inventory availability to support the sales process and enhance sales performance.  
* 
### **Profile**

Skills and Abilities Required


* 3\+ years of operational and inventory experience, preferably in a luxury retail environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, SAP, and other digital tools.
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong knowledge of operations and inventory control.
* Ability to lift and move objects up to 40 pounds.
### **Additional information**

What we offer


At Loro Piana, we believe in fostering a supportive and rewarding work environment that values our employees' well\-being and growth. We offer a comprehensive range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage, fertility support, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, 401K match, and Headspace mental health support. Additionally, employees enjoy a generous product discount, exclusive LVMH discounts, and other tailored perks.


Compensation


Loro Piana uses the published salary range as a guideline to provide our employees with market\-competitive pay while allowing for flexibility to recognize and reward various levels of expertise, performance, and tenure.
  

  

While the published salary range is a good faith reflection of the targeted salary level for the position, Loro Piana reserves the right to pay outside of the published salary range of $24 to $26 USD per hour.
  

  

EEO Statement


We strive to create a culture of inclusion where everyone has a sense of belonging. Our goal is to ensure that our outreach and recruiting efforts generate diverse identities and perspectives that will be valued and can thrive. We are continuously assessing our employee and candidate populations to identify ways to ensure they are all\-encompassing and equitable.


***LORO PIANA***
**MAISON**
---------------------------

Originally from Trivero in northern Italy, the Loro Piana family began trading wool in the early 1800s. In 1924, Pietro Loro Piana founded Ing. Loro Piana \& C., the current company. Pietro’s nephew Franco took over in 1941, and after the war the firm began to establish its reputation as a supplier of premium wool and cashmere textiles for a growing haute couture industry, both home and abroad. In the 1970s, Sergio and Pier Luigi Loro Piana took up the reins, diversifying into luxury goods and developing an international retail arm. Now the world’s foremost cashmere processor, Loro Piana prides itself on sourcing the very finest, rarest raw materials the world has to offer, including unique cashmere from baby goats in northern China and Mongolia, vicuña from the Andes, extra\-fine Merino wool from Australia and New Zealand and lotus flower fiber from Myanmar. The company draws on both time\-honored traditions and state of the art technology to offer its discerning customers products that are renowned for their peerless quality. All of the company’s collections of ready\-to\-wear garments and accessories are made in Italy to the highest standards of craftsmanship and sartorial excellence.

Changing Lives Productions is the in\-house video production company of Dhar Mann Studios, the \#1 creator of scripted positive content online. With over 163 million followers and 45\+ billion views across YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, our videos receive more than 1 billion views each month.



We produce several hours of original content weekly with messages of compassion, kindness, and altruism that resonate with viewers of all ages. Our stories tackle real\-life challenges and deliver powerful life lessons that resonate with global audiences.



Founded by Dhar Mann, named the “Moral Philosopher of YouTube” by The New York Times, a Time Top 100 Creator, and ranked \#2 on Forbes’ 2025 Top Creators list – our founding principle is simple but ambitious: We’re not just telling stories. We’re changing lives.


**BIG PICTURE:**



We are seeking a Social Media Coordinator to launch and run the social media presence of Vertical Dramas, our brand\-new division of vertical short\-form series. These are brand\-new YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok channels starting from zero, and this is the division's first social media hire \- they will own strategy, publishing, community engagement, and audience growth from day one, reporting to the Sr Content \& Social Manager.


**HOW YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME:**


* Develop and execute social media strategies across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook specifically for Vertical Dramas.
* Manage day\-to\-day publishing, scheduling, optimization, and quality control across social channels.
* Create compelling captions, hooks, titles, community posts, polls, and promotional copy designed to drive engagement.
* Partner with creative teams to develop high\-performing thumbnails, short\-form clips, graphics, and platform\-specific content.
* Monitor social trends, viral formats, memes, sounds, creators, and platform updates to identify opportunities for the brand.
* Analyze performance metrics including views, watch time, retention, engagement, shares, follower growth, CTR, and conversions.
* Use performance data to recommend changes to content strategy, creative, posting cadence, and distribution.
* Develop and execute A/B tests for creative, messaging, titles, thumbnails, hooks, and content formats.
* Manage social content calendars and coordinate campaigns around new releases, premieres, partnerships, events, and major brand initiatives.
* Engage with the community through comments, polls, questions, and other interactive formats.
* Track audience sentiment and surface recurring feedback, requests, and content opportunities to internal teams.
* Collaborate closely with Content, Creative, Production, Marketing, Partnerships, and Talent teams.
* Develop strategies to increase followers/subscribers, engagement, reach, and repeat viewership across platforms.
* Monitor competitors, creators, and entertainment brands to identify emerging best practices and whitespace opportunities.
* Prepare regular performance reports highlighting key wins, learnings, trends, and actionable recommendations.
* Maintain a consistent brand voice while adapting content and messaging to the unique audience and culture of each platform.


**WHAT YOU HAVE:**


* Experience with Vertical Drama content is required.
* 3\+ years of experience managing social media for a media, entertainment, creator, consumer, or digital\-first brand.
* Strong understanding of YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and short\-form video strategy.
* Demonstrated ability to grow social audiences and improve content performance.
* Excellent copywriting skills with a strong instinct for hooks, storytelling, titles, and attention\-grabbing social copy.
* Highly knowledgeable about internet culture, Gen Z trends, creators, and rapidly changing social behaviors.
* Comfortable interpreting social analytics and turning data into clear creative and strategic decisions.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple platforms, campaigns, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Experience working with creators, talent, or entertainment IP is a plus.
* Familiarity with social publishing, analytics, project management, and content management tools.
* A strong creative instinct paired with a test\-and\-learn, performance\-driven mindset.


**WHO OVERSEES YOU:**



The Social Media Coordinator will report directly to the Sr Content \& Social Manager


**WHERE IT ALL GOES DOWN:**



Our Social Media Coordinator will work remotely from home or personal office and will be required to utilize Dhar Mann Studios time tracking software to log and submit work hours


**WHEN THE MAGIC HAPPENS:**



The typical work schedule is 40 hours a week, specific times will be discussed during the interview

**Architectural \& Design Community**

Cerno was born from a shared passion for building and creating. At Cerno's core is a friendship that started in childhood. jobs.title: Digital Marketing & Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
***About the Role***

If you live on TikTok, know why some Reels take off while others die quietly, have strong opinions about what makes content feel authentic, and love the idea of helping build consumer brands from the inside keep reading.

Erth Wellness is looking for a creative, highly motivated **Digital Marketing \& Social Media Manager** to own the strategy, growth, and day\-to\-day social presence of our portfolio of consumer brands, including DALY, Daily Pet Co., Erth Wellness, and other emerging brands.

This role will have significant ownership over how our brands show up across social and social commerce. You’ll be expected to evaluate opportunities, make recommendations, test new ideas, and use performance data to determine where we should focus next.

**This is not a role for someone who simply schedules posts.**

We want someone who can spot an opportunity, come up with the idea, grab a phone or camera, create the content, get it live, engage with the audience, look at the results, and figure out what we should do next.

You should be equally comfortable brainstorming a TikTok concept, filming and editing a Reel, setting up products on TikTok Shop, jumping on a trend before it’s over, responding to comments, working with creators, and finding the next opportunity to turn social engagement into actual sales.

You’ll have access to an in\-house photographer and creative resources, but we want someone who is comfortable **creating content themselves** and doesn’t need a full production setup to make something great.

If you’ve worked with **energy drinks, supplements, wellness, fitness, pet products, food \& beverage, or CPG brands**, even better.

***What You’ll Own***

Social Strategy \& Growth

You’ll own the day\-to\-day social presence of multiple Erth Wellness brands across:

* TikTok
* Instagram
* Facebook
* LinkedIn
* TikTok Shop
* Emerging social and social\-commerce platforms

Own the social media strategy, content direction, publishing cadence, and channel growth strategy across multiple Erth Wellness brands.

**You’ll have the autonomy to identify, evaluate, and act on relevant social trends, platform opportunities, creators, content formats, and social\-commerce opportunities without requiring day\-to\-day direction.**

You’ll post consistently, engage with our communities, respond to comments, monitor trends, and find ways for our brands to join relevant conversations without feeling like a brand trying too hard to join a conversation.

Most importantly, we want you paying attention to what’s next: new formats, algorithm changes, creators, trends, sounds, features, platforms, and selling opportunities, and making recommendations on where we should invest our time and resources.

***Create Content People Actually Want to Watch***

We don’t want to create content just to fill a calendar.

You’ll take ideas from concept to execution, including:

* Short\-form video for TikTok, Reels, and Stories
* Product and lifestyle content
* Trend\-driven and reactive content
* Educational and product\-benefit content
* Behind\-the\-scenes content
* Team and personality\-driven content
* Launch and promotional content
* Event and activation content
* Social\-first photography

Photography experience is a big plus. We have an in\-house photographer for larger shoots and polished brand assets, but we’d love someone who can independently capture great product, lifestyle, event, and social content when the moment calls for it.

You’ll also work closely with our photographer, designers, product team, sales team, and leadership on larger campaigns and creative ideas.

This is still a hands\-on role. Strategy and execution go together here. You should be equally comfortable developing the content direction for a brand and grabbing a phone to shoot, edit, and publish something when an opportunity arises.

***Turn Social Into Sales***

A major part of this position will be determining how we use social media and social commerce to drive measurable revenue across our brands.

You’ll own the strategy and ongoing optimization of TikTok Shop and other social\-commerce channels, including:

* Product listings
* Promotions
* Shoppable content
* Creator partnerships
* Affiliate opportunities
* Platform campaigns and initiatives
* Testing new ways to increase conversion

You’ll evaluate performance, identify opportunities, recommend and implement tests, and determine which strategies should be scaled, adjusted, or discontinued based on results.

We want someone who is constantly asking: **“How else can we sell this?”**

***Influencers, Creators \& UGC***

Help us find the right people to talk about our brands.

You'll own the identification and development of creator, influencer, athlete, affiliate, and UGC relationships that align with each brand's audience and business objectives.

You'll develop and manage:

* UGC
* Creator campaigns
* Social collaborations
* Ongoing creator partnerships

You'll evaluate potential partners, recommend where we should invest, monitor performance, and determine which relationships and programs should be expanded, optimized, or discontinued.

***Help Shape and Build Brands***

One of the best parts of this role is that you won’t be working on the same type of product every day.

For **DALY**, you may be creating content around energy, fitness, performance, lifestyle, events, sampling, or a new product launch.

For **Daily Pet Co.**, you could be developing pet wellness content, working with pet creators, supporting a retail launch, or figuring out how to make a gummy supplement for dogs go viral.

For our brands, you'll play a key role in determining how each one should look, sound, grow, engage, and sell through social, while adapting the strategy to the audience, category, stage of growth, and business objectives of each brand.

You’ll also have opportunities to create content around **product launches, retailer launches, trade shows, fitness events, sampling

jobs.description:
**Job description:**

**About TRNSACT**


TRNSACT is a cutting\-edge B2B SaaS platform modernizing how commercial equipment is bought, financed, and protected. Our DealerOS platform helps equipment dealers, lenders, and OEMs streamline credit applications, financing workflows, aftermarket product sales, and compliance — creating a faster and more efficient experience for both customers and internal teams. We’ve already processed billions in volume and partnered with some of the biggest names in commercial equipment finance. Now, we’re expanding our sales team and hiring Business Development Representatives to help drive the next stage of growth.

**The Role**


As a Business Development Representative at TRNSACT, you will be responsible for generating qualified sales opportunities by engaging equipment dealers, lenders, OEMs, and other commercial equipment businesses through outbound calls, emails, LinkedIn, text, and follow\-up campaigns. This is not a generic SaaS sales role. Our customers are often practical, relationship\-driven, and rooted in industries like commercial trucking, construction equipment, agriculture, dealerships, and equipment finance. We are looking for someone who can build trust with blue\-collar and dealer\-focused customers, communicate clearly, and stay organized through a high\-volume sales process. This is a strong opportunity for someone early in their sales career who wants to grow quickly. Our goal is to develop top\-performing BDRs into Account Executives within 3–6 months based on performance.

**Responsibilities**

* Identify, research, and contact potential equipment dealer, lender, and OEM customers through outbound calls, emails, LinkedIn, and other communication channels.
* Create a high volume of qualified sales opportunities through consistent outbound prospecting.
* Manage inbound leads and qualify prospects from first contact through handoff to the sales team.
* Clearly communicate TRNSACT’s value proposition to dealers, finance managers, executives, and other buyers.
* Schedule qualified meetings and partnership opportunities for Account Executives and Business Development Managers.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective customers.
* Track calls, emails, follow\-ups, pipeline activity, and prospect notes in HubSpot, Apollo, and other sales tools.
* Nurture prospects over time to create a steady flow of future opportunities.
* Partner with marketing and sales leadership to improve messaging, campaigns, and outreach strategy.
* Provide feedback to the sales and product teams on customer needs, objections, and market trends.
* Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly activity goals, meeting goals, and sales KPIs.
* Represent TRNSACT professionally with customers who value trust, follow\-through, and industry understanding.

**Requirements**

* 1–2\+ years of sales, business development, inside sales, appointment setting, recruiting, customer service, or phone\-based sales experience.
* Experience making outbound calls, managing follow\-ups, and scheduling qualified meetings.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to build rapport quickly over the phone.
* Comfortable speaking with practical, relationship\-driven customers in industries such as commercial equipment, trucking, agriculture, construction, manufacturing, dealerships, or financial services.
* Highly organized with strong time management and follow\-up discipline.
* Comfortable using CRM and sales tools to manage activity and pipeline.
* Coachable, competitive, and motivated to grow into a closing sales role.
* Able to work independently in a remote or distributed team environment.
* Growth\-oriented mindset with a focus on learning, improving, and hitting goals.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to be resourceful, proactive, and accountable.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior BDR, SDR, inside sales, or appointment\-setting experience.
* Experience selling into dealers, equipment suppliers, lenders, or blue\-collar industries.
* Familiarity with HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or Salesforce.
* Knowledge of the equipment dealership, commercial truck, construction, agriculture, or equipment finance industry.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.

**Why TRNSACT**

* Compensation: $65k – $80k base \+ uncapped commissions (OTE $120k\+ potential).
* Equity: Founding\-level ownership (0\.1% – 0\.1%).
* Impact: You’ll shape the GTM motion, playbook, and culture of the sales org.
* Team: Work directly with the CEO and leadership team on strategy and execution.
* Growth: Chance to grow into sales leadership as the company scales.
* Comprehensive benefits, including health, dental, and vision.
* Remote\-first culture with flexibility.


Benefits:

* Paid time off

  

Work Location: Remote


Compensation Range: $65K \- $80K

**Reports to:** Eileen Ma, DNI Program Director


**Compensation:** This is a Temporary, Non\-Exempt, and Full\-time position. The hourly rate for this position is $34\.66 per hour.


**The Opportunity**


The individual in this role will provide support for and play a coordinating role for the ALC's Election Protection and other voting rights advocacy this fall. The Temporary Project Coordinator will handle administration and logistics for poll monitoring, including correspondence and management of volunteers, polling place assignments, and related components; track and provide support for partner organizations, complete data analysis and research assignments in support of DNI projects, and other admin and support roles related to ALC's democracy defense work. ALC is the nation's first legal organization focusing on advancing and defending the civil rights of Asian and Pacific Islander (API) communities. Since 1972, ALC has fought for access to affordable housing in San Francisco's Chinatown, litigated high\-profile civil rights cases, advocated for the passage of landmark policy changes, and provided an array of services, including community education, advocacy, and direct client representation to further the rights of low\-income immigrants and communities of color, across our Housing Rights, Workers' Rights, Immigrant Justice, and National Democracy Initiative programs, and other emerging areas of law.


**Responsibilities**


Day\-to\-day activities include the following:


* Tracking and management of volunteer recruitment for poll monitoring program
* Correspondence and relationship management with volunteers
* Data analysis and research in support of polling place assignments
* Correspondence with and support for local and national partner organizations.
* Participation in local and statewide policy coalitions or convenings as needed.
* Support for event planning and programming, and other informational/educational opportunities for organizational partners and community members.
* Research and data analysis for democracy projects as needed.
* Writing and editing of DNI resources and publications, such as fliers, factsheets, training materials, presentations, reports, social media content, other toolkits or informational materials for distribution and/or use by partners and ALC.
* Other assignments and administrative duties


**Desired Qualifications**


* Some college preferred
* Demonstrated interest in civil rights and racial justice issues, and commitment to advancing the rights of low\-income, people of color, and/or immigrant communities.
* 1\-2 years of experience working with, serving, or organizing in immigrant communities or historically under\-represented communities, preferably with some civic engagement or voting rights experience.
* Familiarity with California
* Highly detail\-oriented and organized.
* Data analysis and mapping skills: experience analyzing and managing spreadsheets and large quantities of data with geographic location
* Strong written/oral communication skills and strong analytical skills.
* Some graphic design skills, using apps like Canva or other design software.
* Bilingual skills in Chinese, Vietnamese, or another API language preferred.
* Interest in community engagement and policy advocacy
* Enthusiastic team player and self\-starter.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced work environment

jobs.title: Temporary Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Why Join JVS?**


JVS is a nonprofit working to close opportunity gaps in employment by supporting jobseekers with the skills and confidence to secure quality careers with family\-sustaining wages. Grounded in core values of repairing the world and focused on helping our program participants achieve economic mobility, we believe everyone deserves access to training and the chance for a good job. JVS develops training programs in close partnership with employers in high growth sectors, offering high quality jobs.


Building on decades of experience and success, JVS is a data\-driven organization that takes a whole systems approach to addressing employment and economic equity. Through our direct service programs, employer engagement and policy change, JVS is working toward a future where everyone has access to quality education and training programs that lead to high quality employment and economic mobility.  

  

**Job Summary:**


The Temporary Program Coordinator plays a pivotal role in supporting participants throughout their enrollment and career development journeys. This position ensures accurate assessment, application review, and data management, while also providing personalized coaching and guidance.  

The role involves participating in program orientations, developing career action plans, monitoring participant progress, and collaborating with internal teams and external partners. Success is measured by the ability to meet enrollment and cohort targets, support participant retention, and foster positive outcomes in career placement. A strong commitment to equity, inclusion, and excellent customer service is essential. This role is full\-time, limited\-term, and anticipated to end on 06/30/2027\.

**Responsibilities:**

**Application \& Assessment**

* Review and evaluate program applications for candidate suitability.
* Coordinate and participate in interviews using established criteria to determine participant qualifications.
* Enter and maintain accurate participant records and assessment data in Salesforce or similar systems.

**Program Orientation \& Coaching*** Participate in orientations to introduce participants to program expectations, resources, and support services.
* Provide ongoing coaching and feedback to guide candidates through enrollment and career development.

**Participant Journey Management*** Track and monitor participant progress through career action plans and program milestones.
* Meet regularly with participants during their course and job search phases.
* Refer participants to external services for barriers beyond program scope.

**Support \& Engagement**

* Maintain positive connections among participants, staff, and cohorts.
* Process participant resource dollars and support access to necessary resources.
* Inform participants about their progress and required actions to advance.

**Administrative \& Data Management**

* Document participant encounters and barriers in Salesforce.
* Manage schedules to ensure participants stay on track with program and job search timelines.
* Collaborate with partner agencies and other program staff to ensure effective communication with participants and across agencies.

JOB PURPOSE:
  

Perform administrative support duties related to the collection of clinical data and/or the coordination of clinical studies. Work under the close direction and supervision of the principal investigator and/or study coordinator/supervisor.
  

  

CORE DUTIES:
  

Schedule and/or call subjects for appointments; contact participants with reminders or other requirements.
  

Prepare, distribute, and process questionnaires.
  

Perform clerical duties in the preparation of regulatory documents. Maintain all forms and documents, including consent forms and master subject logs. File all appropriate correspondence.
  

Assist with the screening, recruiting, and obtaining consent of study participants. Review medical records and/or perform telephone or in\-person interviews to gather data, as needed.
  

Administer standard study questionnaires and tests, score test measurements and questionnaires, and code data for computer entry. Perform quantitative review of forms, tests, and other measurements for completeness and accuracy.
  

Extract data from source documents for research studies as directed. Collect data and complete case report forms.
  

Perform basic measurements and tests on patients according to protocol, such as obtaining vital signs and performing phlebotomy and EKG, after appropriate training/certification. Collect study specimens according to protocol.
  

Prepare, process, and ship specimens/samples accurately under well\-defined requirements.
  

Order and maintain equipment and supplies.
  

Process study compensation payments and thank you letters to subjects upon completion of trial activities. Assist with post\-study activities, as needed.

jobs.description:
Bay Area therapy practice seeking a part\-time coordinator to manage client intake and provide light support for our office and occasional events.

This role is ideal for someone warm, organized, and detail\-oriented who enjoys being the first point of contact for people seeking care. You'll manage prospective clients from first inquiry through matching them with a therapist and scheduling their first consult call. You'll also help keep our Piedmont office running smoothly with a weekly visit, and lend a hand at a handful of weekend workshops throughout the year.

About the Practice

* 4 therapy offices across 2 locations (plus subleases)
* \~20 clinicians
* 5 supervisors, including the practice founder, who leads workshops
* One virtual office manager (handles payroll and clinician onboarding part time)

Responsibilities

Client Intake

* Serve as the first point of contact for prospective clients (mainly via email)
* Track and follow up with prospective clients through the intake pipeline, with a focus on fast response times — we know prospective clients lose interest quickly if they don't hear back promptly
* Match clients to clinicians based on fit, specialty, and availability
* Schedule first consult calls
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records in our practice management system (e.g., Simple Practice)
* \[nice to have] Identify where prospects drop off and help tighten the process — including using AI tools to speed up response times, draft communications, and improve the workflow

Office Support (weekly, in\-person)

* Visit the Piedmont office once a week to ensure it's organized, stocked, and well cared for (including the plants)
* Flag maintenance or cleaning issues to the appropriate contact and coordinate with our cleaner as needed
* Orient new clinicians to the office space and handle key transfer

Workshop Support (6–8x/year, weekends)

* Support weekend workshops led by the practice founder with setup, breakdown, and food logistics
* Weekend dates provided months in advance

Ideal Candidate

* Warm, professional phone/email presence — comfortable being someone's first contact with therapy
* Organized and reliable; responsive within a consistent window, with urgency around new inquiries
* Proficient with technology\- especially tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Calendar, Sheets)
* \[nice to have] experience using Simple Practice \[this is an intuitive platform \& easy to learn]
* Curious about and comfortable using AI tools to work smarter and faster — interested in building small processes and automations, not just following instructions
* Detail\-oriented and process\-minded
* Comfortable working independently with minimal oversight
* \[Nice to have]: open to light client correspondence on weekends (under 1 hour) — a plus given how much response speed matters to conversion
* Experience working as an intake coordinator or with therapy practices a plus

Logistics

* \~10 hours/week, mostly remote. Ability to correspond with clients within 12\-24 hours key given how much response speed matters to conversion
* One in\-person office visit required weekly
* Workshop support 6–8x/year (weekend dates provided months in advance)
* Weekend responsiveness a plus, not required
* Reports to the Practice Director

Pay: $25\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10\.0 – 15\.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Are you able to come in person once a week to our office in Oakland?
* Do you have any experience with process improvement or using AI to increase efficiency? Please share.
* Do you have experience as an intake coordinator or working in a therapy practice?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Oakland, CA 94605

jobs.title: Brand & Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**BRAND \& MARKETING COORDINATOR (Part\-Time to Full\-Time)**

Brucato Spirits · San Francisco, Mission District

20 hours/week minimum, full\-time preferred

We make amaro, gin, and liqueurs in a small distillery on South Van Ness, using California ingredients: heirloom apricots, house\-dried kumquats, botanicals from the state's fields and landscapes. We're a founder\-run company refocusing on the distillery itself — tours, events, new releases — and expanding distribution within California and . We're hiring one person to work directly with co\-founder Sierra Clark on all of our marketing and public\-facing work.

**ABOUT BRUCATO SPIRITS**

Brucato Spirits is a San Francisco craft distillery founded by Sierra and James Clark, who have formulated every recipe we've released. We're named for John Brucato, founder of San Francisco's first farmers market. Everything is distilled here, and most of our ingredients come from California farms and orchards. Our lineup includes four California amaros, Mission Gin, the Oro y Fierro kumquat liqueurs, and a series of small\-batch releases.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

This is a hands\-on, part\-time role supporting Sierra across brand, marketing, events, and sales. You'll be the person who keeps projects on schedule, turns ideas into finished work, and makes sure nothing gets dropped between a product launch, a photoshoot, a weekend tour, and next week's social media plan.

In your first year, you'll help launch new spirits, run a season of distillery events, contribute to how the brand looks and sounds, and build the systems that keep all of that organized. The role will grow with the company, and how it grows will depend partly on what you bring to it.

No two days will be the same.

**WHAT THE WORK IS ACTUALLY LIKE**

Much of this job is not glamorous. It's proofreading a label for the fourth time, tracking down a vendor who hasn't replied, moving boxes before a photoshoot, updating a spreadsheet, and rewriting a run\-of\-show the night before an event. The interesting parts — launches, shoots, events, learning production — only happen if the detailed work gets done first. We are looking for someone who takes that part seriously.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

● Support new spirits from concept to launch: packaging and label details, timelines, copy, launch materials, and the many small tasks involved in getting a release out.

● Manage social media and the website day to day with Sierra and our partners: content calendars, posting plans, scheduling, and website updates.

● Coordinate distillery events, from tours and tastings to launches and partner nights: planning, logistics, vendors, run\-of\-show, and working the event itself.

● Plan and oversee photoshoots: concept, shot lists, props, scheduling, and directing on set. This may include booking or hiring photographers, stylists, or assistants.

● Create sales and marketing materials (sell sheets, menus, signage, printed pieces, presentations) and manage outside designers or printers when needed.

● Industry and sales support: design and support partnerships, events, and creative activations.

● Contribute creative strategy: bring ideas and help develop campaigns and brand initiatives.

● Represent the brand at tastings, industry events, and with accounts as needed.

**INSIDE THE DISTILLERY**

This role is based at the distillery, alongside the people who make the spirits. You'll learn how production works, and if you're interested in bottling, blending, or distilling, there will be opportunities to participate.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Required**

● At least two years in a role where you were responsible for keeping projects, events, or content on schedule for someone else.

● Extremely organized and detail\-oriented. You keep lists, follow through, and catch mistakes before they go out.

● Creative, with a good eye and the ability to take a rough idea and produce something finished.

● Comfortable talking with the public on a tour, at an event, or behind a table.

● Self\-directed. You identify what needs doing and do it without waiting for instructions.

● Work well in a small team where priorities change and everyone covers more than one job.

● Able to work on\-site in San Francisco most weeks. Set on\-site hours will be decided together with the person we hire.

● 21 or older.

**Nice to have**

● Experience in spirits, wine, beer, hospitality, or food.

● Experience with social media management, photography or art direction, event production, and graphic design (Canva, Adobe Suite, or similar).

**DETAILS**

● Part\-time requires 20 hours per week, minimum. Full\-time option, with additional scope.

● Mostly on\-site at the distillery at set times, with some work from home.

● Occasional evenings or weekends for events.

● Compensation: Part\-time $30\-40/hr, or Full\-time salary of $60\-90K, plus benefits, depending on experience and scope of work.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Email sierra.clark@brucatospirits.com with "Brand \& Marketing Coordinator" in the subject line. Include:

1\. A short note about why you're interested in this role.

2\. A résumé.

3\. One example of something you organized or produced from start to finish — an event, a campaign, a shoot, a launch, a project. In a few sentences, tell us what went wrong along the way and how you handled it.

A portfolio, a social media account you've managed, or other examples of your work are welcome but not required.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 20\.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94103

Over two decades, Save The Bay has become a Bay Area leader in the science and practice of habitat restoration, focused on tidal marsh transition zone habitat at landscape\-scale for recovery of endangered species, and for ecosystem resilience in the face of climate change. We enlist thousands of volunteers annually to restore the shoreline and educate Bay Area students to be the next generation of Bay stewards through hands\-on experiential education and online learning.

* Protect and apply brand standards across all content and platforms, maintaining consistent voice, tone, and visual identity

* Project\-manage Save The Bay’s communications\-driven programs and events — including Climate Conversations and Bay Trail community events

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. **Position Overview**

**This role is based in Phoenix, AZ or Santa Clara, CA in alignment with our flexible work policy. (3 days on site required, 2 days flexible).**

* Experience with contract management and administration is preferred.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Automotive Vertical
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.



Lyft Business is changing the way companies, brands, and organizations alike leverage the Lyft platform to redefine the way they operate. We are solving big problems and meeting the needs of our clients and their people, from employees to customers and students to patients, in a whole new way. We are committed to always delivering best in class customer service. Our work is fun, challenging, and rewarding, and we are looking for a customer\-focused team member passionate about solving problems and delighting our customers.



As an Account Manager, Automotive on the Lyft Business team, you'll help Automotive Dealerships get more out of Lyft and its solutions after the sale. You'll join a talented team focused on one thing: using technology and Lyft's network of drivers to improve transportation for a company's customers and employees. We're looking for smart, ambitious individuals with account management experience who want to transform the way people move around and succeed in a fast moving environment.


**Responsibilities:**
---------------------


* Own a book of existing dealership accounts, with responsibility for retention, adoption, and revenue growth
* Build and manage an expansion pipeline within your accounts by developing trusted client relationships from first renewal conversation to signed expansion
* Accurately forecast, track, and manage revenue, renewals, and churn risk with multiple systems and tools (Salesforce, Claude, Gemini, Outreach, Google Suite, Mode, and Tableau)
* Achieve quarterly retention and net revenue growth targets
* Running quarterly business reviews, monitoring account usage and health data, and re\-engaging dormant users and rooftops
* Be the primary point of contact and build relationships with multiple decision makers across the dealership and dealer group
* Establish collaborative relationships with Lyft Business customers and demonstrate Lyft value to client\-focused initiatives
* Facilitate training, account review, customer engagement, and customer success criteria
* Liaise with internal stakeholders, including Operations, Support, and Product, to resolve client issues and drive the effectiveness of account initiatives
* Represent Lyft at marketing and trade show events
* Travel up to 20% of the time for meetings and visits to client locations
* Reports directly to the Manager of Automotive Sales

**Experience:**
---------------


* 2\+ years of B2B account management, customer success, or renewals experience carrying a retention or growth number (SaaS API integration, ad\-tech, or transportation a plus)
* Proficiency with Salesforce or similar CRM, AI tooling, and a knack for learning new sales tech
* A passion for mobility, the auto industry, or simply making transportation and logistics easy
* Experience owning the post\-sale lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, renewal, objection\-handling, and upsell
* Comfort using usage and performance data to identify risk and surface growth opportunities
* Demonstrated success in exceeding retention or growth targets
* Excellent communication skills \- A big part of the role is talking to clients on the phone and in\-person
* Possess a competitive spirit and are excited to prove not to others, but to yourself, what you are capable of
* High energy, you like to get things done and make things happen
* Self starter, loves to win, and grow professionally
* Ambitious and not afraid of putting yourself out there

**Benefits:**
-------------


* Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
* Mental health benefits
* Family building benefits
* Child care and pet benefits
* 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
* In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
* 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
* Subsidized commuter benefits
* Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership


*Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.*


*Lyft highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in\-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in\-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. \#Hybrid*


*The expected base pay range for this position in the San Francisco area is $23\.08\-$28\.85, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.*

jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and results\-driven Enterprise Account Manager to join our team and spearhead strategic relationships with our most valuable corporate clients. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for enterprise clients, driving business growth through expert account management, innovative solutions, and proactive client engagement. Your energetic approach and strong negotiation skills will help expand our footprint within the enterprise sector, ensuring client satisfaction and long\-term loyalty. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a fast\-paced, technology\-driven environment where your leadership and sales expertise will make a significant impact.

* Develop and execute comprehensive account strategies to foster growth within assigned enterprise clients, identifying new business opportunities aligned with their needs.
* Manage and nurture existing client relationships through regular communication, personalized support, and tailored solutions to maximize client satisfaction.
* Lead negotiations for large\-scale deals, ensuring mutually beneficial agreements that meet both client objectives and company targets.
* Collaborate with marketing and product teams to craft compelling proposals, presentations, and demonstrations that showcase our software solutions’ value.
* Utilize CRM systems such as Salesforce to track sales activities, manage customer data, and generate detailed reports on account performance.
* Conduct warm calling campaigns to engage prospective clients, build rapport, and convert leads into long\-term partnerships.

* Proven experience in technology or software sales within an enterprise or B2B (business\-to\-business) setting, demonstrating success in managing large accounts and closing complex deals.
* Strong negotiation skills with the ability to influence decision\-makers at all levels of an organization.
* Proficiency with sales management systems such as Salesforce or other CRM tools for managing customer relationships and tracking sales pipelines.
* Demonstrated ability in business development, including identifying opportunities, developing strategies, and executing plans to grow accounts.
* Excellent communication skills with a talent for client relationship management, presenting solutions clearly and persuasively.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager, Bilingual (Spanish)
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.  

  

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.  

  

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise\-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.



The Strategic Account Management organization is looking for a tenured, Spanish bilingual customer\-facing professional to manage relationships with some of Square's largest sellers and grow our Restaurant Strategic Accounts program. This program establishes, retains, and grows Square's most valuable and engaged single\-brand sellers.



You will work with business owners and c\-level executives to find creative ways for Square's first and third party ecosystem to solve their complex business needs across verticals and channels. You will enable sellers to grow with Square while serving as an upmarket seller advocate to product teams. Up to 50% of your book of business will be Spanish speaking.



The ideal candidate is a consistent over\-performer on all key performance metrics in their current role. They engage customers and influence internal stakeholders through excellent storytelling, organization, and persistence. They are comfortable leveraging technical frameworks for product solutions and are strongly tuned into commerce trends. They consistently identify "mutual win" opportunities, while navigating complex projects and negotiations. They are driven by serving customers, can work independently, and thrive in ambiguous environments.


*You will:*


* Manage a book of 175 Strategic Food \& Beverage Sellers
* Grow account\-based revenue via use\-case expansion opportunities, cross\-sell opportunities, and customized seller onboarding experiences
* Serve as the voice of the upmarket seller with Product Teams
* Act as a consultant and partner to high value restaurant sellers to accomplish their goals
* Identify opportunities for technical Square solutions to address existing customer needs; project manage the execution of these technical solutions in collaboration with cross\-functional teams
