jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager (San Francisco, California or San Francisco Bay Area)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for a dynamic Strategic Account Manager to join our regional team. This person will be responsible for driving ResMed brand prescriptions and managing strong relationships with our company's key clients.


**The ideal candidate for this role would be located within a reasonable distance of San Francisco, California or San Francisco Bay Area area. Relocation assistance is not available.**

Key deliverables include planning, positioning and strategic marketing of ResMed solutions with referral sources, including but not limited to physicians, sleep labs and other. In addition, building rapport with clients to drive adoption of ResMed brand as clinical preference.


**Let’s talk about Responsibilities:**

* Drive durable ResMed brand prescriptions, identify referral opportunities, and increase patient funnel by leverage existing solutions
* Develop and maintain solid relationships and engagement with clients to drive ResMed branded prescriptions as direct clinical and operational preference
* Acquire a thorough understanding of client and patients’ needs to instill ResMed branded solutions from beginning to end of patient’s journey and to reduce fallout in the patient journey
* Shift client’s clinical preference from diagnosis basis to patient’s long\-term success
* Plan and execute strategies with specialists to drive client adoption of ResMed branded solutions
* Collaborate with support teams through sales process and long\-term implementation of solution(s) using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.
* Professionally represent ResMed as the subject matter expert on the broad portfolio of products and solutions.

**Let’s talk about Key Skills:**

* A data driven mindset to identify how to effectively increase customer funnel
* Ability to interpret key data/reports to clinically and constructively increasing shares
* Analyze client data to understand patient and provider relationship to offer ResMed brand solutions
* The ability to develop a strong business acumen, build trust and creditability with client and gain their adoption to ResMed solutions and products as primary preference
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build rapport with clients and adjust strategy to meet their needs

**Qualifications and Experience:**

**Required**

* 5\+ years of sales experience plus a bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* Prior top ranked medical device, business to business (B2B) or business to consumer (B2C)
* Exceptional sales, negotiating and closing skills
* Experience using Salesforce (SFDC) or similar customer relationship management (CRM) platform.
* Excellence in all forms of communication, effective communicator in upstream and cross channel collaboration
* Motivated, execution and results focus with accountability for continuous improvement.
* Team player with strong work ethic and a can\-do attitude.
* Ability to travel throughout territory as necessary to achieve results

**Why Resmed?**

**Impact at Scale:** Help shape solutions used by millions worldwide.
  

**Global Reach:** Work across regions, teams, and technologies in a truly interconnected ecosystem.
  

**Career Growth:** Thrive in a dynamic, inclusive environment where bold ideas are welcomed.
  

**Purpose\-Driven Work:** Join a company committed to improving lives—one breath, one night, one patient at a time.


**Join Us!**

At Resmed, we believe innovation starts with people. We value diversity of thought, agility, and imagination — and we know that building something meaningful takes leaders who are passionate, humble, and technically sharp.


We are shaping the future at Resmed, and we recognize the need to build on and broaden our existing skills and continue to attract and retain the world’s best talent. We work hard to offer holistic benefits packages, provide flexible work arrangements, cultivate a workforce culture that allows employees to grow personally and professionally, and deliver competitive salaries to our team members. Employees scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week are eligible for benefits. This position qualifies for the following benefits package: comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and life, AD\&D, short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, sleep care management, Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), commuter benefits, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and tuition assistance. Employees have Flexible Time Off (FTO), receive 11 paid holidays plus 3 floating days and are eligible for 14 weeks of primary caregiver or two weeks of secondary caregiver leave when welcoming new family members.


Individual pay decisions are based on a variety of factors, such as the candidate’s geographic work location, relevant qualifications, work experience, and skills.


At Resmed, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current base range for this position is: $90,000\.00 USD Annual \+ TIC.


Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

jobs.title: Services Account Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our \~16,800 employees create world\-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.  

Our award\-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry\-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.  

Keysight’s Global Services organization is seeking an **Expert\-Level Services Account Manager** to drive strategic growth, expand multi\-year service contracts, and deepen account penetration across enterprise, semiconductor, aerospace \& defense, and communications customers in the Northeast region.
This senior individual contributor will own large, complex service portfolios—Calibration, Repair, Asset Management, Uptime Services, Managed Services, and Digital/Software Support—acting as the primary business leader for post‑sales lifecycle value.
You will be responsible for developing account strategy, shaping long\-term customer roadmaps, and aligning Keysight’s advanced service capabilities with customer operational, engineering, and mission‑critical requirements.
Responsibilities:
**Strategic Account Leadership*** Own and grow an assigned portfolio of high\-value enterprise and A\&D accounts throughout the Northeast region.
* Develop multi\-year **Lifecycle Services** strategies tied to customer technology roadmaps and test modernization initiatives.
* Serve as the trusted advisor on test asset strategy, uptime optimization, calibration programs, and operational risk reduction.
* Lead executive\-level service reviews, QBRs, and long\-term service planning discussions.

**Sales Growth \& Business Development*** Drive YoY growth across all Keysight service offerings, consistently delivering against quota and profitability targets.
* Identify whitespace within accounts and introduce advanced solutions including **KeysightCare, Repair \& Calibration Services, Asset Optimization, Test Ops, Managed Services, and Test Automation software services**.
* Build multi\-year contracts leveraging Keysight’s regional service centers and onsite managed service capabilities.
* Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, and service deliverables at expert level.

**Customer Relationship Management*** Own C‑suite, VP\-level, and Director\-level service relationships to ensure customer satisfaction and long\-term retention.
* Engage deeply with engineering, metrology, operations, production, and program teams to understand mission requirements.
* Serve as escalation point for critical service events, outage mitigation, or urgent operational support.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership*** Partner with Field Sales, Services Delivery, Service Centers, Technical Support, and Solutions Consulting to execute customer strategy.
* Collaborate with Legal, Finance, and Operations to structure complex service agreements.
* Lead internal teams during RFPs, contract renewals, and technical solution development.


Qualifications: **Required*** 8–12\+ years in technical account management, services sales, or lifecycle services roles (preferably in test \& measurement, A\&D, semiconductor, telecom, or electronics industries).
* Deep understanding of electronic test equipment, calibration and repair processes, and asset lifecycle management.
* Proven ability to manage complex enterprise customers and close multi\-year service agreements.
* Strong business acumen in negotiation, commercial structuring, and value\-based selling.
* Ability to confidently lead customer executive reviews, service strategy sessions, and program readiness meetings.

**Preferred*** Experience working with enterprise customers in the Northeast corridor—Aerospace \& Defense, semiconductor fabs, network equipment providers, or R\&D labs.
* Understanding of government contracting (DoD, FFRDC, prime/sub relationships) and ITAR/DFARS considerations.
* Familiarity with KeysightCare, TestOps, NPI support structures, and lab modernization programs.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or related field; MBA or technical graduate degree is a plus.

**Core Competencies*** Strategic account planning and executive communication
* Expert\-level negotiation and commercial strategy
* Technical credibility across test engineering and service operations
* Relationship building at all levels
* Problem\-solving and escalation management
* Resource coordination across cross\-functional teams
* Long\-cycle and complex\-deal sales execution

**Success Indicators*** Annual growth of service contract value and penetration rate
* High customer satisfaction and strong renewal performance
* Increased multi\-year service agreements and expanded KeysightCare adoption
* Strong alignment with Sales and Delivery teams to improve customer outcomes
* Development of long\-term, strategic service roadmaps with top regional accounts

  

Pay Range:  

USD $225,190\.00 \- USD $375,320\.00 Year

jobs.title: Business Sales Representative – Territory Accounts
jobs.description:
**Exciting opportunity to be eligible for a $5,500 bonus when you join our team.**


As a **Business Sales Representative – Territory Accounts**, you will own a defined local geography and focus on creating new business with small and mid\-sized companies. This is an acquisition sales role built for a motivated outside seller who is comfortable with various prospecting strategies including cold calling and walking into businesses to set appointments that will then be used to work with the customer to identify their challenges and create solutions to solve your customer’s problems. You will spend most of your time in the market identifying these opportunities, meeting business owners and decision\-makers, and positioning the right AT\&T solutions.

**Earn with confidence and upside.** This role offers a competitive base salary as well as performance\-based commissions tied directly to your sales results. At 100% of target, **annual earnings range from** **$96,800 to $154,100**. Earnings ramp as you build your customer opportunities, develop new customer relationships, and consistently close new business. Your income is directly correlated to your activity, execution, quota performance, and the strength of your sales pipeline.

**What you’ll do day to day:**

* **Balance field and office collaboration:** Sales employees will concentrate on acquiring new business and conducting customer meetings most often, at the customer location. When not in the field, sales employees are expected to collaborate with their team from their assigned office location and place of work.
* **Prospect for new logos:** Identify and pursue new business through customer prospect lists that will be provided and will enable the seller to cold call door knock, and email. The seller will also be able to leverage in\-person customer meetings, work referrals, networking, and local market research.
* **Set appointments and create a pipeline:** Build a consistent approach of customer outreach, qualify prospects, schedule customer meetings, and advance opportunities through the sales process.
* **Own your territory:** Manage a defined geographic territory, prioritize target accounts, understand local business needs, and execute a market plan that supports consistent quota attainment.
* **Sell a broad business portfolio:** Position AT\&T solutions across wireless, fiber, internet, voice, software defined networking and cybersecurity.
* **Serve multiple customer segments:** Engage small and mid\-sized businesses across vertical industries such as retail, professional services, healthcare, construction, logistics, hospitality, and local multi\-site operators.
* **Manage the full sales cycle:** Move opportunities from prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation, close, implementation handoff, and follow\-up.
* **Maintain disciplined CRM activity:** Record calls, visits, appointments, opportunities, next steps, and forecast updates accurately and consistently.

**What you’ll bring:**

* 2–5 years of quota carrying outside acquisition sales experience is ideal.
* Demonstrated success acquiring new business sales through prospecting, cold calling, referrals, appointment setting, and disciplined follow\-up with both customers and in Salesforce.
* Comfort spending significant time in the field visiting businesses, initiating conversations, and building relationships with owners, operators, and decision\-makers.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to uncover customer needs and connect them to AT\&T’s product and solution portfolio.
* Confidence handling objections, negotiating, asking for the sale, and advancing opportunities toward close.
* Self\-disciplined work style and the ability to manage daily activity, Salesforce updates, pipeline health, and quota expectations.
* Ability to collaborate with the team from the assigned office location, if available, when not acquiring new business or conducting customer visits in the field.
* Valid driver’s license, satisfactory driving record, current auto insurance, and reliable transportation to support field\-based selling.


Selling for AT\&T means bringing a recognized brand, broad product portfolio, and established business reputation into every customer conversation. You will receive paid training, sales support, coaching, and access to tools that help you build pipeline and grow your book of business. For sellers who consistently perform, this role creates a path into larger territories, advanced sales roles, account management, leadership opportunities, and long\-term career across AT\&T.

**Ready to close the deal on a career with AT\&T?**


Apply today.


\#MidMarketSales


Our Specialist Sales Exec S1\-Territory Fib jobs earn between $51,800\.00 \- $77,600\.00 \+ commission $45,000 . Not to mention all the other amazing rewards that working at AT\&T offers. Individual starting salary within this range may depend on geography, experience, expertise, and education/training.
**Joining our team comes with amazing perks and benefits:**

  

* Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Tuition reimbursement program
* Paid Time Off and Holidays (based on data of hire, at least 23 days of vacation each year and 9 company designated holidays)
* Paid Parental Leave
* Paid Caregiver Leave
* Additional sick leave beyond what state and local law require may be available but is unprotected
* Adoption Reimbursement
* Disability Benefits (short term and long term)
* Life and Accidental Death Insurance
* Supplemental benefit programs: critical illness/accident hospital indemnity/group legal
* Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)
* Extensive employee wellness programs
* Employee discounts up to 50% off on eligible AT\&T mobility plans and accessories, AT\&T internet (and fiber where available) and AT\&T phone

jobs.description:
**Sales Development Representative (San Francisco, CA)**  

You don't pay us. We pay you.


SV Academy is hiring Sales Development Representatives. This is a full\-time job that includes free sales training, a 90\-day paid Residency at a partner company, and a clear path to a long\-term sales role at one of our 400\+ partner companies.


Cohorts begin every week and are limited to **25 Residents**. Apply early to be considered for the next available start date.

**Compensation**

* **Days 1–10** — Free sales training. No tuition, no fee, no debt. Live, instructor\-led training on Zoom, Monday through Thursday, 6–9 pm (EDT or PDT).
* **Days 11–100** — Paid Residency. $2,500/month base \+ 100% of the commissions you earn. You'll be a W\-2 employee of SV Academy, embedded at a partner company.
* **Day 100 onward** — Transfer to the partner's payroll. $65k \- $100k in total annual compensation (base \+ commission). Full health, dental, vision, and retirement benefits begin the day you transfer to the partner.


No tuition. No loans. No deferred\-income agreement.


We're paid out of the hiring budget the partner was already going to spend — which means our incentive is to make you successful in the role!

**How the 100 Days Work**

**Days 1–10** — Free sales training. Ten days of live, instructor\-led training. Monday through Thursday, 6–9 pm (EDT or PDT), on Zoom. No cost to you. You'll learn the fundamentals of B2B sales: outbound calls, email and LinkedIn outreach, objection handling, qualification, CRM and sales engagement tools (Salesforce or HubSpot, Outreach or Salesloft, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

**Days 11–100** — Paid Residency at a partner company. You'll work full\-time at one of our partner companies as a W\-2 employee of SV Academy. Real sales work: outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn; qualifying inbound leads; scheduling discovery meetings for Account Executives. You'll get daily coaching from an SV Academy mentor and from the partner's sales leadership.

**Day 100** — Transfer to the partner. Successful Residents transfer directly onto the partner's payroll at the compensation above, with full benefits starting that day.

**About SV Academy**


Since 2017, we've placed more than 6,000 people into full\-time tech sales careers and worked with 400\+ employer partners across SaaS, AI, fintech, cybersecurity, and other high\-growth verticals.


Led by CEO Michael Colonnese, a 15\+ year veteran of workforce development focused on building debt\-free pathways into tech careers.


Our partners pay us. You don't. That's the entire business model.

**Who Tends to Succeed Here**


No prior sales experience required. We hire people who are:

* Competitive and motivated by clear goals
* Comfortable on the phone, including cold calls
* Coachable — you take feedback and act on it
* Resilient — sales involves rejection, and you can keep going
* Strong written and spoken communicators


If you've worked in retail, hospitality, customer service, fundraising, fitness instruction, teaching, or any role where you spent your day talking to people and meeting goals — you already have the foundation to be excellent at this.

**What Happens After You Apply**

* Apply through this posting — takes about 3 minutes.
* We respond within 2 business days. If you're a fit, we'll set up a 20\-minute intro call.
* Cohort placement. If you move forward, we'll match you with a partner company and a start date. Cohorts begin every Monday and are limited to 25 Residents — apply early for priority consideration.

**Apply today.** The next cohort starts soon and spots fill on a first\-reviewed basis.

 **Requirements**  

  

Required Qualifications:* English proficiency sufficient for professional work communication
* Permanently authorized to work in the United States without need for sponsorship


Preferred Qualifications:* Completed Bachelors degree
* Experience in a customer\-facing role such as retail, hospitality, customer support, fundraising, or account management
* Experience in a goal\-driven role with measurable targets (quotas, KPIs, bookings, revenue, or activity metrics)
* Ability to attend evening sessions during the 2\-week bootcamp
* Strong communication skills
* Confident and engaging communicator
* Excited by ambitious goals and motivated by a high\-performance environment

  

**Benefits**  

* Comprehensive 2\-week online bootcamp training
* Paid 3\-month residency with an employer partner
* Hybrid work environment
* Exposure to leading technology companies and sales teams
* Professional development and mentorship opportunities
* Supportive community and network of peers

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, Inbound
jobs.description:
**A Better Built World**
------------------------


At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure \- roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.


For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on\-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.


That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.


This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double\-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $50M\+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started.

**About the Team \& How We Work:**
----------------------------------


Our SDR team is the engine behind Miter’s pipeline growth — and we’re scaling it fast. As an Inbound SDR, you’ll be the first to connect with contractors who raise their hand to learn more about Miter, responding fast and turning that interest into qualified pipeline. You’ll work hand in hand with Marketing and Account Executives to make sure no opportunity slips through the cracks.


This is a high\-impact seat with plenty of room to get creative. You’ll help sharpen our qualifying and follow\-up motions, tie prospect pain to the right Miter modules, and shape a repeatable inbound playbook as the product evolves — working alongside sales, marketing, and leadership to test new ideas and accelerate revenue growth.


As the first point of contact for many of our future customers, you’ll set the tone for strong, lasting relationships and help contractors see the value of modern, industry\-leading tools. We’re committed to your growth: SDRs at Miter have a clear path into senior SDR roles, Account Executive positions, and beyond.

 **What You’ll Do:**

* Be the first point of contact for inbound leads — demo requests, content downloads, and marketing\-sourced leads — responding with a time\-to\-touch under 15 minutes
* Run qualifying and discovery conversations to surface prospect pain and tie it back to the relevant Miter modules
* Communicate Miter’s value proposition and business impact, booking qualified meetings (SALs) for Account Executives and managing clean handoffs
* Follow up persistently with every lead that no\-shows or doesn’t self\-book, re\-engaging across phone, email, and other channels
* Partner closely with Marketing on campaigns and lead quality, and own your activity and pipeline metrics in Salesforce

**What You’ll Need:**

* No prior experience required — prior SDR work, cold calling, or transferable experience from college (athletics, leadership, part\-time sales) is a plus
* Highly organized — you can juggle a high volume of inbound leads and follow\-ups, staying on top of every prospect without letting anything slip through the cracks
* Strong written and verbal communication — as the first point of contact at Miter, you’re energetic, personable, and make a great first impression
* A natural relationship builder who partners closely with AEs, asks sharp questions, and stays genuinely curious about every prospect
* Self\-motivated and coachable, with a strong desire to build a long\-term career in Sales
* Grit, resilience, and a strong work ethic — you bring consistent energy and bounce back quickly from a “no”
* A true team player above all — you win as a team and lift up the people around you

**Our Interview Process:**

* Recruiter Screen
* Hiring Manager Interview
* Take Home Assignment
* Final Executive Interview

**Our Benefits:**
-----------------

* **Competitive Compensation:** We offer competitive (well above “market”) salary, commission, and equity packages.
* **Medical Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, FSA, vision plans to suit you and your family’s needs.
* **401(k) Retirement Plan:** Company\-matched contributions to help you plan for your future.
* **Flexible PTO:** Take the time you need to recharge and be your best self.
* **Parental Leave:** Generous 16\-week paid leave for all parents, including adoptive and foster parents.
* **Learning \& Development:** We offer every employee an annual educational allowance to explore external professional development.
* **Office Extras:** Snacks, coffee, lunch, and commuter benefits for in\-office Mitosaurs.
* **Community**: Company\-wide and team\-specific off\-sites per year.

**Hybrid vs. Remote Approach:**
-------------------------------


We believe the magic of Miter comes from working side by side. We also believe in work flexibility. For roles that are listed as **hybrid,** our approach is 3 days a week in the office giving us the chance to connect, brainstorm, and build stronger relationships. If you live within a reasonable commute to either our New York City or San Francisco offices, we ask that you work in our hybrid approach.


Otherwise, for roles listed as **remote** or in other cities where we don't have an office location, there is no requirement to work in our hybrid approach. We do travel a few times a year for onboarding, company\-wide and team specific off\-sites!


**Join our Talent Community**
-----------------------------


Not seeing a role that matches your background right now? **Apply to our Talent Community****,** and we’ll reach out if a role opens up that aligns with your experience!

**Equal Opportunity:**
----------------------

### **Who We Are**



Simpplr is the AI\-powered intranet for unifying the digital workplace. It brings people, trusted knowledge, apps, and agents into a coherent digital experience. Powered by a proprietary EX Knowledge Graph, Simpplr synthesizes signals and context across connected systems to deliver personalized information and actions. The platform serves as a digital hub supporting communications, engagement, employee services, and work. With low\-code extensibility and enterprise\-grade security and governance, Simpplr enables confident operation at scale. More than 1,000 organizations — including AAA, the NHS, Penske, and Moderna — trust Simpplr to keep their workforce informed, aligned, and productive. Learn more at simpplr.com.

### **The Opportunity**



We are looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our team!



At Simpplr, we know that the key to growth is a high\-performing sales team. That’s why we’re seeking a qualified sales development representative (SDR) to find and screen potential customers who could benefit from our products and services. As the first line of communication with a prospect, the ideal SDR has a strong understanding of the sales process and excels at qualifying leads, starting new relationships, and setting up sales closers for success. The SDR should be a quick learner who has strong communication skills and an ability to showcase our offerings compellingly. Every potential customer is an opportunity for boosting top\-line revenue growth, customer acquisition levels, and profitability.

#### **What you will be doing:**

* Generate new business opportunities to fuel the sales pipeline
* Call, Email, and use social touches to follow up with Inbound Marketing Leads promptly
* Engage in conversation to qualify inbound marketing leads based on qualification criteria.
* Evangelize Simpplr both internally and through your inbound efforts
* Achieve monthly quotas of sales accepted opportunities and sales qualified opportunities (Stage 2 \& Stage 4\)

### **Your Skillset**


#### **What makes you a great fit for our team:**


* Have an interest in sales, a sales background, or 0\-6 months of SDR experience
* Proven track record of quota and KPI attainment
* A driven individual who thrives on success and winning
* You have demonstrated strong verbal and written communication skills including responding to inquiries both on the phone and via email
* Demonstrated strong problem\-solving skills to help decode a prospect's pain points through a short conversation
* You have been able to learn, from formalized instruction and also self\-discovery, how to best present the benefits of the product you are selling

Simpplr is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or genetics.

jobs.description:
The Clinical Research Coordinator will perform independently or with general direction at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Supervisor and/or Principal Investigator (PI); may coordinate the data collection and operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies.


Incumbent’s duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; coordinate staff work schedules, assist with training of Assistant CRCs, and assist Clinical Research Supervisor and/or PI with oversight of other research staff; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.


  
Required Qualifications


* HS graduation and sufficient experience and demonstrated skills to successfully perform the assigned duties and responsibilities; and/or equivalent experience/training.
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments and outside institutions; and the ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population.
* Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines.
Previous CRC experience  
* 

Preferred Qualifications


* Fluency in the usage of Committee of Human Research (CHR) online iMEDris system for submission, renewal, and modification of protocols through this system.
* Understanding of patient population to create rapport and a relationship, while also giving insight to what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation.
* Certification by the Society of Clinical Research Associates or the Association of Clinical Research Professional
* Experience with electronic medical records.
* Knowledge of UCSF and departmental policies for dealing with reimbursement, guidelines for research, confidentiality and HIPPA regulations, following the UCSF mission statement and purpose for research, and a clear understanding of policies and procedures on patient safety and confidentiality (electronic and hard copy medical records, patient charts, communication, etc.); knowledge of medical terminology, research policies and guidelines, guidelines for packing/shipping infectious substances, database building/analysis, and data management within some of the following: Access, Stata, SASS/ SPSS, and Teleform programming platforms.
* Experience applying the following regulations and guidelines:
	+ Good Clinical Practice Guidelines
	+ Health Information and Accountability Act (HIPAA)
	+ The Protection of Human Research Subjects
	+ CHR regulations for recruitment and consent of research subjects
	+ Effective Cash Handling Procedures
	+ Environmental Health and Safety Training
	+ Fire Safety Training

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate\-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10\-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells.  

  

**Pride Values**  

UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values .  

  

In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Additional information about UCSF is available here .  

  

Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide.

jobs.description:
#### **Help make the world more hospitable**

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that's just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we're transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.



You'll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You'll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you'll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we're building.



If you're motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you'll feel at home here.


#### **About the role**



Let's get into the specifics. It's impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:


North American hotel operators are running on legacy, on\-premise technology that creates system fragmentation and manual workarounds across everything they do. This BDR role exists to continue to expand the West Coast market for Mews, building qualified pipeline from the first cold call to the booked discovery meeting.

You will work across the West Coast territory, owning outbound prospecting to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and group procurement contacts. The pipeline you build is the commercial foundation for everything Mews does in the West Coast.

**What you would do**
* Run multi\-channel cold outreach including calls, emails, and targeted sequences to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and procurement contacts, converting conversations into booked discovery meetings for the Account Executive team
* Research and tier new business opportunities in the West Coast market, building pipeline on your own initiative
* Track and report pipeline activity to your direct manager on weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadences
* Feed market intelligence from hotel operators back to your regional commercial team to sharpen targeting and outreach approach
* Utilize AI often to do research and prospecting

**What you would bring**
* Ideally at least six months of experience in an outbound\-facing role where you initiated contact and handled rejection, whether BDR, SDR, inside sales, or a high\-contact customer\-facing position
* Hospitality experience strongly encouraged
* A genuine connection and passion to hospitality, through hotel operations, front desk, reservations, events, food and beverage, or deep curiosity about how hotels work, so you can speak credibly to a GM from the first call
* Clear written and verbal communication in both languages, with the ability to adapt your tone for different decision\-maker profiles

**AI Fluency Level 2:** In practice, this means using AI to draft and personalise outreach to hotel GMs, giving it real context about the property, the GM's known situation, and the tone that works with hospitality operators, then reviewing and editing before anything is sent. You are actively experimenting with AI sequencing tools and research assistants and building a view on what produces better results with North American prospects. Every message that reaches a prospect is yours.

  

*For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to* *"AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates"* *on Confluence.*


**Nice to have**
* Familiarity with Salesforce and outbound platforms such as Outreach, Salesloft, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Deep hospitality knowledge

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**About the Company**


Marcus \& Millichap Company (MMC) is a real estate leader and pioneer with a diverse family of companies offering Real Estate Services, Real Estate Investments, and Real Estate Development. Each MMC company is a distinct fusion of real estate specialization and innovation, powered by a culture of loyalty that permeates throughout the Marcus \& Millichap organization. To find out more about the Company, visit www.mmcrealestate.com.


Please note that we are in a great location, near Caltrain, with excellent restaurants and shops within walking distance.

**Position Overview**


The Executive Assistant is a strategic partner to senior leadership, responsible for optimizing executive effectiveness, managing high\-priority workflows, and driving coordination across stakeholders. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, judgment, and anticipation in a fast\-paced, high\-demand environment.


The position requires a proactive, highly polished professional who can manage complexity, influence outcomes, and serve as a trusted extension of the executive, while exercising exceptional discretion in handling highly sensitive and confidential information.


The position reports to the Chief of Staff and is based at the Company’s headquarters in Palo Alto, CA.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Executive Operations \& Strategic Calendar Management**
	+ Own and optimize executive calendars to align with strategic priorities
	+ Proactively identify scheduling conflicts, competing priorities, and opportunities for efficiency
	+ Ensure executives are fully prepared with context, materials, and clear objectives
	+ Maintain organized records, files, and documentation systems
* **Executive Meeting, Board \& Event Leadership**
	+ Lead planning and execution of executive, board, and other key leadership meetings, including board and investor interactions
	+ Develop agendas, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure alignment on desired outcomes
	+ Drive follow\-through and accountability on key action items
* **Strategic Communication \& Stakeholder Interface**
	+ Draft and manage executive communications with a high degree of discretion and judgment
	+ Serve as a trusted liaison for sensitive and confidential matters involving senior stakeholders
* **Travel, Expense \& Executive Logistics Optimization**
	+ Oversee complex travel planning with contingency planning and efficiency in mind
	+ Ensure logistics maximize executive productivity and minimize friction
	+ Monitor and improve administrative processes related to expenses and logistics
* **Executive Information \& Relationship Management**
	+ Maintain and synthesize key executive information, stakeholder insights, and priorities
	+ Manage relationships and ensure continuity across executive interactions
	+ Anticipate next steps and ensure continuity in stakeholder engagement
* **Strategic Projects \& Executive Enablement**
	+ Lead special projects and cross\-functional initiatives
	+ Conduct research, build executive\-ready presentations, and drive deliverables
	+ Identify opportunities to improve executive workflows and operating cadence

**Core Competencies**

* **Judgment \& Executive\-Level Decision Making** – Makes high\-quality decisions in complex situations
* **Ownership, Accountability \& Reliability** – Takes full ownership of outcomes and execution
* **Executive Communication \& Influence** – Builds trust and influences across stakeholders
* **Proactivity, Anticipation \& Adaptability** – Anticipates needs and resolves issues proactively

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required
* 5 to 8\+ years of executive support experience, including senior leadership exposure
* Proven experience supporting complex, high\-demand executives
* Exceptional communication, organizational, and problem\-solving skills
* Proven ability to manage highly sensitive information with discretion, judgment, and professionalism

**Benefits Overview**


The compensation plan for this role is commensurate with the skills required for the position. As such, it is comprised of a base salary and an annual performance\-based incentive, which is determined upon individual and portfolio performance.


The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including:

* Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, and Paid Sick Time
* 401k \+ Employer Contribution
* Medical (H.S.A./HDHP option \+ Employer Contribution), Dental, and Vision Plan(s)
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Group Term Life/AD\&D and Voluntary Life/AD\&D Plans
* Long\-Term Disability and Long\-Term Disability Buy\-Up Plans
* Employee Assistance Program
* Fitness \& Wellness Program
* Other Voluntary Plans


Depending on the role, other benefits such as commissions, an educational assistance program (tuition reimbursement), a referral program, and/or a car allowance may be applicable.

NYRR’s year\-round offerings of races, community events, programs, and training resources provide hundreds of thousands of people with the motivation, know\-how, and opportunities to start running and keep running for life. NYRR’s premier event, the famed TCS New York City Marathon, attracts the world’s top professional runners and committed amateurs alike, while also raising millions of dollars annually for charity and driving economic impact for New York City. NYRR is equally committed to the runners of tomorrow, passionately providing youth fitness programs that educate and inspire children in underserved communities in New York City, nationwide, and around the world.

jobs.title: Event & Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Government technology has failed citizens, public servants, and service members for decades.


Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses for counter\-drone procurement to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI\-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks and months, not years.


This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies.


Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital.

**Before You Apply...**
-----------------------


This is Kaizen's first dedicated events hire, and it's a build role. Our events have been run part time alongside other responsibilities. We have a conference presence, a set of shows we return to, and a handful of rooms that have worked well, but no owner and no playbook. You'll set the strategy, own the calendar and the budget, and be accountable for what the program produces.


The center of the role is the federal conference circuit: the Washington\-area shows and agency\-facing conferences where our federal buyers gather, the field motion that surrounds them, and the executive dinners and briefings we run alongside them. State and municipal events sit underneath the federal calendar rather than beside it. Kaizen\-hosted events are a real ambition and you'll scope what we should own, but that work follows the circuit rather than leading it.


Events at Kaizen are a growth function, measured against pipeline and qualified meetings rather than attendance. Our buyers are public servants, and how we show up in a room is a direct statement about the quality of what we build. Politics is not a criterion at Kaizen: we don't screen for ideology, and we expect you to build trusted relationships on both sides of the aisle.

  

**Location**
------------


This is a hybrid role based out of our New York City HQ or our DC office. Candidates must reside in New York or DC, or be able to commute to New York City or DC to work out of our office at least three times a week (Tuesdays \- Thursdays).

  

**Who You Are**
---------------

* You've built an events program rather than inherited one, owning the strategy, the budget, the vendor bench, and the measurement
* You know the federal conference landscape, or you'll learn it quickly, and you can tell a show that draws program offices and CIOs from one that only draws vendors
* You have strong taste and can defend it. You've walked a venue and known it was wrong, and you've ended a sponsorship everyone assumed would renew
* You think in pipeline rather than attendance, and you've defended an events budget with something more rigorous than photos and a headcount
* You're comfortable in the operational detail: shipping, badge scans, AV failures, staffing, and the seating chart that determines whether a dinner works
* You're credible with senior government audiences, from a two\-star Army general to an agency CIO to a contracting officer
* You manage vendors, agencies, and production partners by directing their output rather than depending on it
* You thrive with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments, and you self\-generate the agenda rather than waiting for one
* You're AI\-pilled and default to these tools in your daily workflows
* You're emotionally intelligent, thoughtful, and empathetic toward public sector missions

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Own Kaizen's events strategy end\-to\-end.** Build and run the annual calendar, anchored to the federal buying year: fiscal year\-end, agency budget windows, and the conferences where our buyers actually show up
* **Decide where Kaizen shows up and where it doesn't.** Evaluate conferences and sponsorships, negotiate levels and booth placement with organizers, and be willing to walk away. A defensible no matters as much as a good yes
* **Own our physical presence.** Booth design, demo staging, collateral, and swag that match the caliber of the product, along with the vendors and production partners who build them
* **Run the field motion alongside sales.** Account targeting, pre\-event outreach, on\-site meeting scheduling, team travel and staffing, and the follow\-up that determines whether the show produced anything
* **Own the satellite program around major shows.** Executive dinners, agency roundtables, and closed\-door briefings, most of them in Washington, where the highest\-value conversations often happen off the show floor
* **Land Kaizen leadership on stage and in the content.** Speaker placement, panel submissions, and awards in partnership with Brand \& Storytelling and Government Affairs, with photo, video, and customer story capture planned into the run\-of\-show
* **Scope and build Kaizen\-hosted events.** Define what we should own, whether a summit, a dinner series, or a recurring briefing, and determine whether we host it outright or co\-host with a govtech company, consulting firm, or systems integrator
* **Own the budget and the reporting.** Manage spend and tradeoffs across the program, and build reporting with BizOps that ties events to pipeline, qualified meetings, and cost per meeting
* **Navigate federal ethics rules.** Gift and hospitality limits vary by agency and shift again at the state and local level. Work with Legal to design programs that are both generous and compliant

  

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 4\-10 years in events, experiential marketing, or field marketing, with direct ownership of strategy and budget rather than execution alone
* Demonstrated experience owning a conference circuit: which shows to commit to, what a spon

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------


As an Account Manager at HUMAN, you will own and grow relationships with a portfolio of customers and partners. You will be responsible for customer experience, adoption, retention, renewals, and expansion across HUMAN’s solutions.


You will serve as a trusted advisor to key stakeholders, understand their business priorities, identify risks and opportunities, and translate customer needs into clear internal action. Success in this role requires a blend of relationship\-building, consultative selling, strategic thinking, commercial discipline, and hands\-on problem\-solving.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Build and maintain meaningful relationships with customer stakeholders and decision\-makers, serving as a primary point of contact and developing a strong understanding of their goals, business priorities, challenges, and experiences with HUMAN’s products and services.
* Drive product adoption by confidently sharing product knowledge, best practices, and recommendations that help customers realize value.
* Develop account strategies and actionable plans that increase customer value over time.
* Identify, prepare, and execute upsell and cross\-sell strategies that support customer outcomes and revenue growth.
* Lead renewal planning and facilitate seamless renewals by identifying risks early and coordinating the right internal resources.
* Identify and execute growth strategies that produce upsell and cross\-sell opportunities.
* Analyze account health, performance, engagement, and portfolio trends to identify growth opportunities, risks, and proactive next steps.
* Lead customer\-facing business reviews, strategic planning sessions, and presentations that clearly communicate performance, priorities, and recommendations.
* Partner with Product, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Solutions, and technical teams to resolve issues, deliver strong customer outcomes, and act on customer feedback, market needs, and product or service gaps.
* Maintain strong pipeline discipline, account visibility, and timely reporting in Salesforce and other internal systems.
* Represent HUMAN at relevant industry events and use those interactions to strengthen customer relationships and bring market perspective back to customers and internal teams.
* Manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining strong follow\-through and a high standard of customer care.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 8\+ years of experience in account management, partner development, consultative sales, or a closely related commercial role, with a track record of carrying and executing against a defined quota.
* Experience in ad tech, media, digital advertising, or a closely related technology ecosystem, with familiarity across relevant platforms and categories such as ad servers, SSPs, DSPs, exchanges, verification, fraud, and brand safety.
* A demonstrated ability to think strategically, identify business objectives and challenges, and translate them into compelling value propositions and action plans.
* A strong record of relationship\-building and consultative upselling and cross\-selling.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and executive communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with senior customer stakeholders and internal executives.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to use account context, customer data, and market knowledge to shape smart next steps.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills, a collaborative and solutions\-oriented approach, and the ability to operate with autonomy in a fast\-paced environment with some operational ambiguity.
* Strong organizational discipline, commercial judgment, and attention to detail.

**About HUMAN Security**


HUMAN was founded in a Brooklyn sci\-fi bookstore with a hacker mindset and the lofty mission of making the internet safer by putting humans first. Today, our Human Defense Platform safeguards enterprises from sophisticated bots, fraud, and account abuse, verifying the humanity of more than 20 trillion interactions per week for the world’s biggest brands and internet platforms.


HUMAN is an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to protecting the internet's integrity for everyone. We believe in putting people first, embracing diversity of thought from our global teams, and welcoming all individuals to share their unique experiences as we fight cybercrime together. We support our Humans with a comprehensive total rewards package for personal and professional development, including well\-being and learning stipends, flexible work options, and dedicated time off. While our HQ is in NYC, we have teams worldwide.


HUMAN is growing fast, and there’s never been a more meaningful time to join us. If you thrive on solving complex problems and want to help shape the future of cybersecurity, join us as we build a safer, more human internet.


If you are an individual with a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us directly.


Compensation Range: $120K \- $145K

--------------


Healthcare needs a better rhythm: one that keeps care continuous and deeply human. Heidi is building an AI Care Partner that works alongside clinicians to make that possible.


We’re a team of doctors, engineers, designers, researchers, and creatives building tools that help clinicians stay focused on what matters most: their patients.


In just 18 months, Heidi has given back more than 18 million hours to healthcare professionals — supporting 73 million patient visits in 116 countries. Today, more than two million patient visits each week are powered by Heidi worldwide.


Backed by nearly $100 million in funding, we’re growing in the US, UK, Canada, and Europe, partnering with leading health systems including the NHS, Beth Israel Lahey Health, and Monash Health.

We're looking for an Account Manager to lead AI\-native growth across your specialty pod in the US. This is a quota\-carrying, consultative sales role: you will diagnose friction in a customer's workflow, build the business case for the agent that solves it, and own the relationship all the way through renewal.

* Forecast expansion pipeline accurately, backed by frequent customer touchpoints and clean data

**What we're looking for**

* A track record of hitting or exceeding quota in a commercial or account management role, ideally across both seat\-based and usage\-based (credit\-consuming) models
* Deep clinical understanding, or the ability to earn it fast. You need to be credible in the room with clinicians, not just executives. Healthcare or health tech experience, a plus

* Great at making complicated things easy to understand
* You’re a natural relationship builder with a hunter mentality
* You’re a cross\-functional collaborator \- you represent the customer internally with ease and can reign in cross functional teams to solve complex issues

jobs.title: Account Manager - 3PL
jobs.description:
The **Account Manager \- Third\-Party Logistics (3PL)** is responsible for managing, retaining, and growing strategic customer relationships. They serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for their assigned accounts and are responsible for driving customer satisfaction, retention, operational performance, and long\-term revenue growth. They partner closely with customers and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities, resolve challenges, and ensure service excellence. The position requires a deep understanding of customer operations and supply chain strategies, and the ability to leverage data to identify growth opportunities, lead business reviews, resolve complex challenges, and deliver solutions that enhance customer value and profitability.

 **Pay Range:** $72,000\-$88,000 per/year

 **Category Focus: 3PL Partnerships**  

* Support a portfolio of third\-party logistics partners and transportation intermediaries.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer transportation networks, operational requirements, and business objectives.
* Build and strengthen relationships with key decision\-makers across assigned 3PL accounts.
* Identify opportunities to increase shipment volume, expand share of wallet, and grow existing business.
**Responsibilities:**  

* Manage a portfolio of strategic customer accounts.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, building and maintaining strong relationships with customer stakeholders across operational, commercial, and leadership levels.
* Understand customer supply chain strategies and align solutions to support those initiatives.
* Position the Company as a preferred transportation provider within partner logistics networks.
* Monitor and analyze account performance, revenue trends, customer satisfaction, and retention risks to identify opportunities and recommend actions.
* Identify organic growth opportunities, share\-of\-wallet expansion opportunities, and additional transportation solutions within existing accounts.
* Establish and maintain customer\-specific performance metrics and fact\-based reporting to identify root causes, lead corrective action planning, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Create, prepare, and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and executive business reviews, presenting operational and financial performance, identifying opportunities for growth, and developing strategic action plans.
* Act as a customer advocate within the organization, influencing internal stakeholders and aligning resources to support customer commitments and business objectives.
* Drive account retention, expansion, and profitability by identifying growth opportunities, developing strategic account plans, and supporting contract renewals and commercial negotiations.
* Maintain accurate account plans, customer activity, business opportunities, and pipeline visibility within Salesforce and other business systems.
* Partner with Operations, Customer Service, Pricing, Commercial, and other internal teams to improve account performance, customer experience, and long\-term retention.
* Partner with Sales on growth opportunities, RFP responses, customer expansions, and win\-back initiatives.
* Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitive activity to identify growth opportunities.
* Support customer onboarding, implementation activities, and service launches.
* Manage customer escalations, service concerns, and operational challenges through effective cross\-functional collaboration.
* Maintain CRM documentation, account activity, forecasting information, and customer records.
* All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.
**Qualifications**  

* Education: Undergraduate degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field from an accredited college or university required.
* Experience: 3\+ years’ experience in logistics, transportation, 3PL, account management, or a related customer\-facing role preferred.
* Deep understanding of transportation, LTL, expedited, or related freight operations preferred.
* Strong relationship management, analytical, communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to identify revenue risks, growth opportunities, and customer retention strategies.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and build effective relationships across functions.
* Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information.
* Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.), CRMs (Salesforce), and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.)
* Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in an on\-site setting (listed in this posting), with travel for related meetings/events.

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad\-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners \- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.


This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically\-acclaimed, industry\-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.


**SiriusXM** is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising\-supported audio products. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.


**How you’ll make an impact:**


The Marketing Specialist, Aviation \& Marine Services, plays a key role in owning and executing defined marketing initiatives that drive brand awareness, engagement, and subscriber growth for SiriusXM’s Aviation and Marine lines of business. Loro Piana is an Italian luxury Maison founded in 1924, known for creating the finest quality textiles, ready\-to\-wear collections, accessories, and bespoke garments. We're looking for a gritty, hungry self\-starter who isn't afraid to pick up the phone and put in the work. The Business Development Representative (BDR) is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role responsible for generating and qualifying new business opportunities with clinical operations, feasibility, and digital innovation leaders at pharmaceutical and biotechnology sponsors.


This is a top\-of\-funnel role built for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced, competitive environment, gets energized by hitting big numbers, and wants to grow fast inside a company that rewards performance. If you love the grind, love the win, and want to work in a space where what you do genuinely matters, this is your seat.

  

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Outbound Prospecting \& Lead Generation**


* Prospect into target accounts in pharma and biotech using multi\-channel outreach (phone, email, LinkedIn, conference follow\-up) to drive top\-of\-funnel activity
* Research and identify key decision\-makers within clinical operations, feasibility, patient recruitment, digital health innovation, and medical affairs teams
* Conduct high\-volume, personalized outreach campaigns aligned with marketing initiatives and industry events
* Leverage account\-based strategies to penetrate top\-tier pharmaceutical and emerging biotech organizations

  

  

**Inbound Lead Qualification**

* Qualify inbound leads from marketing programs, webinars, conferences, and website inquiries
* Conduct discovery calls to uncover pain points around feasibility forecasting, patient recruitment and retention, site engagement, and protocol execution
* Assess organizational fit, budget authority, timeline, and technology stack to prioritize high\-quality opportunities

  

  

**Discovery \& Needs Assessment**


* Execute structured discovery conversations to understand current recruitment workflows, site training models, and patient engagement challenges
* Map sponsor pain points to ProofPilot's capabilities across feasibility, awareness, recruitment, retention, and site support solutions
* Clearly articulate ProofPilot's differentiated value proposition: white\-label branding, true end\-to\-end platform, holistic patient and site journey visibility, and GxP compliance

 **Meeting Setting \& Pipeline Contribution**


* Schedule qualified product demos and discovery meetings for Account Executives with well\-documented notes on stakeholders, pain points, timelines, and competitive landscape
* Hit and exceed the core KPI: 5\+ net new qualified meetings with ICPs per month
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records in HubSpot CRM on activities, leads, contacts, and opportunity progression

 **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Partner closely with Marketing on campaign execution, messaging refinement, and event follow\-up strategies
* Provide structured feedback from the field on messaging effectiveness, objections, competitive signals, and market trends
* Collaborate with Sales leadership to refine ideal customer profiles, qualification criteria, and prospecting playbooks

 **IDEAL CUSTOMER PROFILE \& MESSAGING FOCUS**


**Target Personas**


* Clinical Operations Leaders
* Feasibility and Study Planning Teams
* Patient Recruitment and Retention Managers
* Digital Health and Innovation Directors
* Medical Affairs and Clinical Science Teams
* CRO and Site Network Partners

* Inaccurate enrollment forecasting and antiquated feasibility models (only 20% of trials finish on time)
* Low study awareness (55% of patients don't join trials due to lack of awareness)
* Poor referral\-to\-randomization conversion rates and high patient dropout (30% drop out due to complexity)
* Overburdened sites managing multiple vendors and inadequate training (90% of sites learn on the first few patients)

* True End\-to\-End Platform: Replace fragmented multi\-vendor ecosystems with a single Clinical Experience Platform
* White\-Label Branding: Maintain sponsor brand continuity and trust throughout the patient and site journey
* Holistic Visibility: 360\-degree view of patient and site engagement with real\-time performance metrics
* Proven Results: 40% improvement in site compliance, higher conversion rates, better patient engagement
* Compliance Excellence: GxP, HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA, CFR Part 11, and SOC2 Type 1 certified
* Award\-Winning: Industry\-recognized solution backed by pharma, patient, and site experts

 **QUALIFICATIONS**


**Required**


* Experience in a BDR, SDR, or inside sales role in B2B SaaS (we care more about your hunger and track record than your resume length)
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding pipeline generation and meeting\-setting quotas
* Comfortable with high\-activity outreach and structured, data\-driven pipeline management
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex problems into concise, outcome\-focused value propositions
* Self\-motivated, coachable, and wired for a fast\-paced, competitive environment
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience

jobs.description:
Title: Research Coordinator


Location: Upper East Side


Org Unit: Samie R Jaffrey Lab


Work Days:


Weekly Hours: 35\.00


Exemption Status: Exempt


Salary Range: $68,200\.00 \- $77,500\.00


* As required under NYC Human Rights Law Int 1208\-2018 \- Salary range for this role when Hired for NYC Offices


**Position Summary**
--------------------



Under direction, monitors all data management, regulatory and financial aspects of clinical trial operations. This role also coordinates special research projects, prepares internal board protocols for clinical research, assists in the design of evaluation tools/instruments and coordinates budgets.


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Develops and implements practices to ensure research efficiency by routinely analyzing and evaluating workflow.
* Coordinates the collection, compilation, documentation and analysis of clinical research data from various clinical sites. Assists in the determination of guidelines for the collection of clinical data and or administration of clinical studies.
* Ensures compliance of general and study specific regulatory related processes with SOPs, FDA, NIH, and applicable regulations for the reporting of events to regulatory agencies.
* Develops regulatory reports and associated documentation in accordance with SOPs and study specific processes.
* Prepares study related budgets for granting agencies. Negotiates study related budgets with various sites, departments and sponsors.
* Researches and develops the recruitment strategies. Employs modeling and simulation tools to understand the current and projected outcome of recruitment techniques. Monitors and evaluates the success of varying subject recruitment techniques.
* Participates in protocol development as it relates to patient recruitment. Assesses, analyzes, prepares and submits departmental protocols to various places as it relates to subject recruitment and retention.
* Performs monitoring visits: pre\-study, initiation, routine monitoring and closeout visits.
* Works closely with sponsor, site and study personnel on relevant regulatory issues. Develops policies and procedures pertaining to regulatory and monitoring processes. Leads regulatory educational training events for personnel at various sites.
* Maintains inventory of supplies, equipment and/or reagents. May order supplies/equipment/reagents as authorized or ensure that needs are escalated appropriately. Receives supply orders and confirms accuracy of delivery. May assist with cost control.
* Performs other related duties as directed.
**Education**
-------------


* Bachelor's Degree in related field
**Experience**
--------------


Approximately 2 years of experience in health\-related role, in clinical or research setting**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**
-----------------------------------


* Experience with conducting and carrying out protocols and research coordination.
* Familiarity with IRB interaction, regulatory policies, database input and report generation.
* Research experience in an academic health center with exposure to a team research environment at all levels (senior investigators, nurses, research coordinators, lab technicians).
**Licenses and Certifications**
-------------------------------


**Working Conditions/Physical Demands**
---------------------------------------


Standard office work

jobs.description:
225 Varick Street, Suite 301, New York NY 10014, United States
 9000 SS \- NY \- Home Office
**Our secret to leading the way in hospitality? We put our people first!**


At Shake Shack, our mission is to Stand For Something Good in all that we do. From our teams to our neighborhoods, we're committed to always doing the right thing. As one of the fastest\-growing hospitality brands, we're all about crafting unforgettable experiences for our guests. We offer endless learning opportunities and the chance to make a lasting impact on our business, restaurants, and communities. As a member of the \#ShackFam, you’ll have access to hands\-on mentorship, training, and growth potential, all in a fun and inclusive environment.


Join us and Be a Part of Something Good.

**Job Description**

This position is located at Shake Shack’s New York City Support Center. It supports our Chief Legal Officer (and other senior members of the Legal team) and our Chief Financial Officer.  

  

Our Executive Assistants are highly\-respected because their skills are quite simply, essential. You’d be a key member of a dynamic, fast\-paced team that serves as a center of excellence for the enterprise, partnering with leadership across lines of business. “EQ” skills to build bridges, forge alliances and encourage people to want to work with you.


You’re a calm head and steady hand to deal with everyday challenges and the unexpected.

**This role is in office 4 days a week mininum.**

**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities**

**Administrative \& Calendar Management (30%)**

* Interface directly with other senior executives and their support teams to calendar key meetings.
* Understand each day’s priorities so you can be strategic about how you direct inquiries and requests.
* Prepare agendas, materials, notes and key next steps for large cross\-functional meetings.

**Document Management (20%)**

* Prepare documents for execution and distribution
* Review, sort, and distribute all department mail
* Print, photocopy, scan, and/or save documents
* Maintain and update database for department documents

**Travel Coordination (15%)**

* Create a multi\-city travel itinerary, taking into account time zones, weather delays, traffic and fatigue levels.
* Coordinate these schedules between executives based in multiple cities.

**Expense \& Vendor Management (15%)**

* Support expense reports and execute signatures/approvals for vendor contracts, purchase orders, etc.

**Event Planning (10%)**

* Plan and execute high profile events, including quarterly earnings calls and investor meetings
* Plan department meetings and social events

**Efficiency \& Executive Support (10%)**

* Champion efficiency, executive time and a willingness to go the extra mile without being asked.

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Communications, or a related field

**Work Experience:**

* 2–4 years of relevant experience
* At least 3 years supporting a Vice President or higher\-level executive.
* At least 3 years supporting multiple executives, preferably in different departments

**Skills \& Competencies:**

* Solid written and verbal communication skills, including strong grammar and a rich vocabulary
* Ability to multi\-task and prioritize deadlines/deliverables.
* Excellent judgment, discretion and common sense
* Intellectual curiosity to learn about the Legal and Finance team’s work and the Shake Shack business as a whole
* Strong proficiency with all types of computers, phones, and equipment, as well as Microsoft Office programs
* Must demonstrate a sense of urgency and ownership to drive issues and tasks to completion
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
* Excellent organizational and planning skills

**Benefits at Shake Shack:**


A work environment where you can come as you are, share your ideas, have fun, and work collaboratively:

* Weekly Pay and Performance bonuses
* Shake Shack Meal Discounts
* Exclusive corporate discounts for travel, electronics, wellness, leisure activities and more
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance\*
* Employer Paid Life and Disability Insurance\*
* 401k Plan with Company Match\*
* Paid Time Off\*
* Paid Parental Leave\*
* Access to Employee Assistance Program on Day 1
* Pre\-Tax Commuter and Parking Benefits
* Flexible Spending and Dependent Care Accounts\*
* Development and Growth Opportunities

* Eligibility criteria applies


Pay Range \- $88,843\.75 \- $116,656\.25 **About Us**


Beginning as a hot dog cart in New York City’s Madison Square Park, Shake Shack was created by Danny Meyer, Founder and CEO of Union Square Hospitality Group and best\-selling author of Setting the Table. Shack Fans lined up daily, making the cart a resounding success, and donating all proceeds back to the park beautification efforts. A permanent stand was eventually built…and the rest is Shack history! With our roots in fine dining and giving back to the community, we are committed to high quality food served with a high level of hospitality. Our team members enjoy a positive work environment that is deeply committed to the philosophy that we "Stand for Something Good."
