jobs.title: Grants Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Hemophilia of Georgia, Inc.  

Job Description
Position: Grants Program Coordinator Status: Exempt
Supervisor: Senior Director of Policy \& Compliance Work Location: Hybrid Travel: 15% international
Funding: Funding for this position is provided through program (PHS) resources within the organization.
  

Hemophilia of Georgia (HoG) is a nationally and internationally recognized nonprofit organization that provides programs and support services for people with hemophilia, von Willebrand Disease, and other bleeding disorders. HoG is the only agency of its kind in the state and is dedicated to enhancing the health and wellness of the bleeding disorder community by providing excellence in comprehensive health care, education, advocacy, and the support of research to transform lives.
  

Commitment to HoG Culture:  

* Maintain a positive work atmosphere by acting and communicating in a manner so that you work productively, effectively, and efficiently with customers, clients, co\-workers, and management.

  

* Hemophilia of Georgia operates an annual summer camp program for children and teens with hemophilia and other inherited bleeding disorders. Camp is typically held in the summer (which may include the Fourth of July) and runs Saturday\-Friday, and the date changes each year. Camp is an agency\-wide, strategic priority; therefore, all exempt employees must participate. Assignments may include duties at camp, helping campers get to and from camp, and may involve overnight travel. The Director of Camp \& Client Events will provide advance notice to exempt employees of where support is needed. PTO requests during the week of camp are generally not approved; however, PTO requests for extenuating circumstances will be reviewed on a case\-by\-case basis by the Chief Community Engagement Officer.

  

Position Summary
The Grants Management Coordinator provides administrative, programmatic, and operational support for HoG's domestic and international grants, cooperative agreements, or other grant\-funded activities. This role serves as a key liaison with external partners and stakeholders, helping ensure effective communication, collaboration, and the successful implementation of grants, cooperative agreements, or other programs that advance the organization's mission. The Coordinator manages the full grant lifecycle, including coordinating Requests for Proposals (RFPs), administering the grant submission platform, tracking budgets and deliverables, maintaining grant records, ensuring compliance with grant requirements, and supporting reporting, data collection, and program documentation. Domestic and international travel is required to support program implementation, monitor grant activities, and support organizational goals.
  

Qualifications:
  

Required Qualifications  

* Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Public Administration, Nonprofit Management, or a related field.
* 2 to 5 years of experience in nonprofit operations, grant writing, administrative coordination, or compliance support.
* Exceptional English writing, editing, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft clear and persuasive proposals and reports.
* Strong project management, organizational, and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word, including budgeting and financial tracking.
* Experience using grant management, CRM, and reporting systems.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Strong cross\-cultural communication, relationship\-building, and diplomatic skills.

  

Essential Functions:  

* Manage the full grant lifecycle, including award administration, compliance monitoring, partner deliverables, budget oversight, and reporting requirements of HoG non\-federal grants and cooperative agreements.
* Lead the development of high\-quality grant proposals, project narratives, logical frameworks, budgets, and other funding applications in collaboration with executive leadership.
* Monitor project implementation and expenditures to ensure alignment with funding requirements, federal regulations, organizational policies, and approved project plans.
* Prepare, compile, and review narrative, financial, statistical, and operational reports for internal leadership.
* Maintain accurate grant records, tracking systems, databases, award documentation, reporting schedules, and communication logs.
* Serving as liaison between the organization and external customers, recipients, and awardee community to clarify, interpret, and resolve issues
* Evaluate the effectiveness of grants management systems and processes; conduct analyses and recommend improvements to strengthen compliance, efficiency, and program performance.
* Collaborate with executive leadership to develop, implement, interpret, and continuously improve grant management policies, procedures, and operational practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for HoG’s international grants and cooperative agreements through project execution and building relationships with funding partners
* Implement the planning, execution, monitoring, and evaluation of international grant\-funded projects and cooperative agreements.
* Monitor project implementation, track spending, reconcile accounts, and manage budget revisions for international projects.
* Foster collaborations to leverage resources, expertise, and networks.

  

Additional Responsibilities:  

* Additional duties as assigned by the Chief Policy \& Compliance Officer

jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant \& Business Operations Coordinator**



As the **Executive Assistant \& Business Operations Coordinator**, you will play a key role in supporting the company’s legal, regulatory, and executive functions. You’ll manage corporate entities, licenses, permits, compliance deadlines, and acquisition\-related activities while providing high\-level administrative support to the President and senior leadership. This role is ideal for a highly organized, discreet, technology\-forward professional who can manage competing priorities, build strong relationships across the organization, and use technology and AI to streamline processes and support a growing company.


**What You’ll Be Doing**


* You will manage the lifecycle of corporate legal entities, including formations, registrations, annual renewals, filings, maintenance, and dissolutions across multiple states and jurisdictions.
* You will oversee liquor licenses, business licenses, food service licenses, hotel licenses, permits, and other regulatory requirements across the company’s properties and locations.
* You will maintain compliance calendars, licensing records, corporate documentation, and audit\-ready files while proactively tracking deadlines and renewals.
* You will coordinate with outside legal counsel, registered agents, government agencies, Accounting, Operations, Human Resources, Business Development, and property leadership to ensure compliance requirements are completed accurately and on time.
* You will support new acquisitions, management takeovers, property openings, and transitions by coordinating entity formations, EINs, state registrations, licenses, permits, and required documentation.
* You will assist with due diligence, M\&A activities, financing, audits, and other legal and corporate projects as needed.
* You will maintain corporate governance records, including organizational documents, resolutions, minute books, cap tables, and organizational charts.
* You will manage the transfer, renewal, and closure of licenses associated with property openings, ownership changes, property sales, and entity dissolutions.
* You will support brand and investor administration, including employee ID setups, annual investor tax document distribution, and maintaining accurate property and business unit records.
* You will serve as a company notary public for corporate and legal documents.
* You will use technology, automation, and AI tools to improve compliance tracking, document management, renewal processes, and recurring administrative workflows.
* You will manage complex calendars, travel arrangements, meetings, correspondence, expenses, and other administrative responsibilities for the President and senior leadership team.
* You will coordinate executive meetings, offsites, and board meetings, including logistics, materials, follow\-up items, and communication.
* You will serve as a trusted liaison between the President’s office, internal departments, external partners, board members, and other key stakeholders.
* You will handle confidential legal, financial, executive, and personal information with a high level of discretion and professionalism.
* You will continuously identify opportunities to improve processes, automate recurring work, and create scalable systems as the organization continues to grow.


**Education \& Experience**


* Paralegal certificate, degree, or equivalent professional experience in corporate or legal compliance.
* Three (3\) or more years of experience managing corporate compliance, licensing, regulatory filings, or related legal administration.
* Hospitality, restaurant, alcohol beverage, multi\-state real estate, or franchise industry experience, highly preferred.
* Experience managing multi\-state business licenses and/or liquor licenses.
* Experience supporting C\-suite executives in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiarity with state Secretary of State filing systems and Alcohol Beverage Control (ABC) processes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and document management platforms such as SharePoint.
* Experience navigating state, county, and municipal filing portals.
* Hands\-on experience using AI or automation tools to streamline legal, compliance, administrative, or document\-management processes.
* Active notary public commission, or willingness to obtain one shortly after hire.


**Essentials**



To be a successful candidate, you will need the following:


* Eligible to work in the United States.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage a high volume of recurring deadlines across multiple states, entities, properties, and executives.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, outside counsel, government agencies, and property teams.
* High degree of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential legal, financial, executive, and personal information.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills with the ability to exercise sound judgment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Ability to build collaborative relationships and work effectively across multiple departments while balancing competing priorities.
* Technology\-forward mindset with the ability and willingness to use AI, automation, and digital tools to improve efficiency.
* Ability to embrace HVMG’s Culture of Excellence by demonstrating professionalism, a positive attitude, and a commitment to exceptional service.
* Amazing opportunities for career advancement across HVMG
* Flexible PTO
* Up to 40% earned wages paid BEFORE payday with PayActive
* Full Healthcare Benefits (including medical, dental, and vision coverage)
* 401k Retirement Plan with a guaranteed 4% match and no vesting
* Hotel and Food and Beverage Discounts and Perks


**Careers at HVMG**

Our **Be Excellent culture** is more than just words

**Job Description**


The Heidelberg Sales Account Manager, Labels, is responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with existing and prospective customers within an assigned territory covering East Coast. This position specializes in the Gallus portfolio of label printing and converting solutions, including digital and flexographic label presses, workflow software, inspection systems, and related consumables.


As a consultative sales professional, the Sales Account Manager works closely with label converters, packaging printers, and brand\-focused manufacturing organizations to understand their production requirements, operational challenges, and growth objectives. By leveraging technical knowledge of label manufacturing processes and Heidelberg's label production technologies, the individual develops customized solutions that improve productivity, print quality, automation, and profitability.


The Sales Account Manager \- Labels serves as a trusted advisor throughout the equipment investment lifecycle, guiding customers through equipment evaluations, workflow assessments, ROI analysis, capital equipment purchasing decisions, installation planning, and long\-term partnership development. This role bridges the gap between technical production capabilities and customers' business goals, helping organizations remain competitive in the evolving label and packaging marketplace.

 **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Identify and qualify prospective label converters, packaging printers, commercial printers entering the label market, and other target customers within the assigned territory through networking, prospecting, industry research, trade shows, digital resources and working collaboratively with the Heidelberg/Gallus sales team.
* Develop and maintain strong, long\-term customer relationships by understanding label production workflows, business objectives, operational challenges, and future growth plans.
* Promote the Gallus portfolio of label solutions, including digital and flexographic label presses, workflow automation solutions, inspection technologies, and ancillary production equipment.

* Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline utilizing Heidelberg's CRM platform and sales management processes.
* Prepare and deliver compelling presentations, equipment demonstrations, ROI analyses, and business proposals to executive, operational, and production stakeholders.

* Experience selling capital equipment, production technologies, workflow software, or manufacturing solutions preferred.

This role comes with a defined career progression path mapped out at approximately the 18\-month mark, a full sales tech stack on day one, and finalized ICP and buyer personas before you start. jobs.title: Operations Analyst III - Connectivity - Development & Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**
===============


As a global leader in digital infrastructure, QTS designs, builds and operates advanced data centers that support strategic AI, cloud and digital transformation initiatives. We are driven by a mission to connect the world for good and our people make it possible. Every single day, the creativity, dedication and genuine care for our communities are what push us forward and make this a truly special place to be.


The **Operations Analyst III \- Lead** will support Technology Operations leadership in shaping the department's strategic direction. This role will provide recommendations based on comprehensive data analysis to drive continuous improvement and innovation within our Customer Service Management and Infrastructure Operations functions. Responsibility also includes leading and managing complex projects aimed at improving operations performance. Specifically, this role focuses on more advanced analytic techniques such as predictive modeling, machine learning, and data mining. Historical and forecasted data are used to identify potential risks and opportunities to guide strategic decision\-making. Additionally, high\-level stakeholder engagement to communicate findings, provide recommendations and progress, and collaborate on operational initiatives that support broader business objectives is required. Demonstrated commitment to growth in this technical role is expected, and behavior and actions aligned with the QTS Customer Creed.

**RESPONSIBILITIES \- other duties may be assigned.**

* Conduct comprehensive reviews and analyses of company’s operational processes to identify inefficiencies, gaps, and areas for improvement.
* Implement robust monitoring and tracking mechanisms and develop real\-time dashboards for critical business operations such as requisitions, budgeting, and service management.
* Proactively identify deviations from established control points and recommend corrective actions.
* Cultivate and maintain strong working relationships with 3rd party providers to ensure seamless integration of services and adherence to contractual agreements and service level agreements (SLAs).
* Expertly analyze datasets from various business applications to uncover valuable insights and trends that inform strategic decision\-making and operational improvements.
* Produce concise and insightful summary reports and compelling data visualizations to effectively communicate key findings and trends to management and other stakeholders.
* Propose innovative solutions and strategies to optimize processes, reduce costs, and enhance overall operational performance.
* Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success criteria in a clear comprehensive manner.
* Monitor and report on the status of project actions and initiatives while ensuring alignment with project timelines and goals.
* Recommend changes to existing policies and procedures based on data\-driven insights and best practices to enhance efficiency, compliance, and effectiveness.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to streamline processes, improve operational efficiency, and deliver high\-quality end\-to\-end solutions.
* Craft polished and professional written communications to convey complex ideas and findings to diverse audiences.
* Conduct detailed financial analysis and develop forecast models for improvement in operational performance and resource allocation.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Master of Business Administration (MBA) or equivalent advanced degree/professional experience.
* Seven or more years of IT or related professional experience.
* Experience with data analysis, including Excel pivot tables, charting, formulas
* Experience with relevant applications, such as ServiceNow, ScienceLogic, and/or Salesforce.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office suite.
* Solid understanding of business forecasting and procurement processes (requisition submission, invoicing, and impact to budget).
* Able to create dashboards or reports using data analytics methods.
* Proficiency in using analytical tools and software such as Excel, SQL, Tableau, or other data visualization and analysis tools. Knowledge of ERP systems or database management systems may also be required.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Four or more years of relevant IT operations or process management experience
* Project management certification (e.g., PMP) or relevant training
* ITIL v3/v4 Foundation or Agile certification
* Data analytics certification
* Experience managing, reforecasting, and reconciling budgets of $1M\+
* Experience managing third\-party provider and vendor relationships
* Demonstrated proficiency in advanced data analysis techniques, statistical modeling, and predictive analytics can be preferred for roles that require in\-depth analysis and forecasting
* Experience in leading projects that include cross\-functional teams' collaboration

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Strong alignment of operational initiatives with organizational goals
* Excellent stakeholder engagement abilities for collaboration on operational improvements
* Strong project management skills with a focus on timelines and objectives
* Expertise in creating visualizations and reports
* Demonstrated financial acumen for informed decision\-making and resource optimization

**TOTAL REWARDS**


This role is also eligible for a competitive beneﬁts package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; ﬂexible spending and HSA accounts; paid holidays; paid time off; paid volunteer days; employee assistance program; tuition assistance; parental leave; military leave assistance; QTS scholarship for dependents; wellness program, and other company beneﬁts.


This position is bonus eligible.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.



Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.



The Role

  


Within the Business Development Representative (BDR) role, we support outbound sales teams by assisting them through strategic prospecting efforts and extensive account research. BDRs consistently make a tangible impact in the Sales Development Organization by generating millions of dollars of new business pipelines each year.



What You'll Do

  

* Generate new business pipeline primarily through prospecting outbound opportunities
* Nurture early\-stage opportunities
* Gain interest through outbound cold calling across a set of existing BT customers and breaking into net new logos in assigned territory
* Partner with Account Executives to identify and source net new pipeline and assist by researching lines of business and personas
* Identify key decision makers within new accounts
* Create a great first impression to our prospects and customers by providing them with a world class experience
* Maintain active engagement with new and existing customers through creative follow\-up communications designed to increase customer interest in BT
* Achieve monthly quotas of sourced qualified opportunities
* Enter prospect information into Salesforce.
* Enhance product knowledge through regularly attending training sessions.
* Support marketing campaigns and promotional offers to help optimize revenue.


What You'll Bring

  

* 1\-2 years experience in business development, sales or related field experience
* Ability to work in a fast paced environment. You think out\-of\-the\-box and wow people with your interesting angles and quality work
* Experience researching, account planning, prospecting, and cold calling into a large list of accounts that are a hybrid of net\-new and existing install
* Proven track record of achieving sales metrics and consistent achievement of year\-over\-year quota attainment
* High school diploma or equivalent
* Ability to effectively communicate with internal and external stakeholders
* Personality to establish and maintain strong relationships with sales teams you support and become a valued partner to them.
* Ability to multi\-task, prioritize workload, and maximize efficiency.
* Effective listener to understand prospect needs.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Strong desire to be in technology sales
* Strong problem\-solving skills
* High energy and positive attitude
* Ability to take initiative
* Solid phone, prospecting, sales, customer service, and interpersonal skills


Nice To Have

  

* Knowledge of Customer Relationship Management tool
* Familiarity with Software/Cybersecurity


Better Together



Diversity. Inclusion. They're more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.



We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.



About Us



BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity\-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.



BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.



Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Napa Home \& Garden, a dynamic home décor wholesaler, with its headquarters in Norcross, GA is searching for a driven, energetic team player to join our growing team. We provide sophisticated products for the home, selling to style\-conscious retailers via a best\-in\-class shopping experience. Napa is well\-recognized within the home décor industry and is one in a family of highly regarded brands.**

**Job Purpose**


The Digital Marketing Specialist owns website performance marketing for our newest sales channel DTC and our legacy B2B sites, along with the other digital assets that support them. This is a hands\-on execution role reporting to the Senior Director of Business Development. Your focus splits roughly 80/20 between DTC and B2B support. The Senior Director sets content strategy and campaign calendars. You will own day\-to\-day execution across site merchandising, conversion optimization, SEO, site analytics, content, and our other digital assets, partnering with Design, IT, and Sales to get work live. Strategy and the campaign calendar sit with the Senior Director; your input on what's working is expected, and the role can grow into strategic ownership as you build a track record. You'll help keep our Shopify storefront fresh, contribute content ideas, and use AI tools to move fast without losing the friendly design\-forward voice that defines our brand.


**Duties and responsibilities**

  

* Own the execution of website performance marketing for DTC and B2B, plus the campaigns and content that run across the website and other digital assets.
	+ Collaborate with Design to build, schedule, and launch campaign assets across the website and our other digital assets, from brief to live.
	+ Adapt messaging and creative for DTC and B2B audiences.
	+ Analyze campaign and site performance against the calendar set by the Senior Director, flagging timing conflicts early and recommending initiatives to optimize execution and improve performance.
* Own website performance end to end: day\-to\-day operation of the Shopify storefront, including updates, merchandising, promotions, conversion optimization, and technical integrations like metafields and app setups.
	+ Schedule and Publish daily/weekly site updates (product launches, copy changes, navigation, and landing pages)
	+ Merchandise collections and homepage placements to feature seasonal and best\-selling product.
	+ Build and schedule promotions, bundles, discount codes, and sale mechanics end to end.
	+ Configure metafields, theme sections, and app integrations, with support from IT and freelancers on anything custom.
	+ Monitor site health (broken links, page speed, checkout errors) and resolve or escalate quickly.
	+ Run on\-site conversion testing (product page layout, imagery, copy, promo placement) using Lucky Orange and Shopify data, and implement the winning variant.
	+ Maintain a continuous testing roadmap — hypothesis, test, result, next step — with a running log of what shipped and what it moved.
	+ Own site analytics in GA4: event and conversion tracking, funnel and landing\-page reporting, and channel attribution across all traffic sources.
	+ Diagnose conversion drop\-off by device, template, and traffic source, and turn findings into a prioritized queue of site fixes.
* Drive organic and paid traffic growth to the site, and measure its impact on sessions, conversion rate, and revenue.
	+ Implement SEO and AEO best practices across product, collection, and landing pages, aligned to the strategy set by the Senior Director.
	+ Support paid media campaigns as budgets are established.
	+ Track rankings, organic traffic, and content velocity in SEMrush, Google Search Console, and GA4\.
* Support B2B marketing initiatives under the direction of the VP of Marketing and Sales.
* Track and report on performance to inform strategy.
	+ Pull weekly metrics from Shopify, Klaviyo, Sprout Social, GA4, and Lucky Orange.
	+ Provide regular performance reports to your manager, with observations and suggested next steps where you see them.
* Utilize AI tools such as Jasper, Claude, and Shopify Magic to streamline content creation.
* Collaborate with internal teams (IT, creative, sales) and external partners on projects and integrations.


**Skills and Qualificiations**


* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3\-5 years in digital marketing (ecommerce site management, performance marketing, or content), including hands\-on ownership of website performance and campaign execution.
* Solid copywriting skills for the website and other digital assets, with writing samples to share.
* Demonstrated hands\-on Shopify experience (merchandising, navigation, landing pages, promotions and discount mechanics).
* Working SEO/AEO knowledge applied to live ecommerce pages, with interest in growing into more strategic work.
* Hands\-on GA4 experience — conversion and event tracking, funnel and landing\-page reporting, and channel attribution.
* Comfort designing and reading structured A/B tests on live pages, and acting on the result.
* Comfortable using AI tools for content creation.
* A strong design sense and appreciation for design\-led brands.
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Curious, self\-motivated, and comfortable in a fast\-moving environment.
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Exposure to both DTC and B2B content for a consumer brand.
* Background in home décor, furniture, interiors, gifting, or consumer goods.
* Familiarity with Shopify app ecosystems and theme customization.


**What Success Looks Like**



You'll be measured on:


* Site conversion rate and revenue per session
* Click\-through rate (CTR) and campaign performance
* Testing velocity and win rate on site experiments
* Organic traffic growth and content production velocity
* Engagement and audience growth across other digital assets
*

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly experienced individual with a proven record of driving results to join our team as Business Development Representative!

This is an opportunity to work for a closely held company that is developing market share and growth in the Atlanta, GA and Charlotte, NC markets. Our company specializes in providing comprehensive Tree Care services to high end residential, commercial, and industrial clients**. Sesmas Tree Service, LLC** is led by ownership and management with decades of experience in the green industry.

The primary role of the Business Developer is to prospect for new clients by networking, cold calling, marketing, or other means of generating interest from potential clients.

* Works closely with an assigned sales manager and pursues business opportunities within established markets.
* Develop solutions and perform presentations. Work with our team to develop proposals that get to the root of the clients' needs, address their concerns, and achieves their objectives.
* Participate in pricing the solution/service.
* Handle objections by clarifying, emphasizing agreements, and working through differences to a positive conclusion. Use a variety of styles to persuade or negotiate appropriately.
* Responsible for providing general account management to assigned customer accounts including sales presentations, customer service, and contract renewals.
* Works closely with the operations team operating in the assigned market.
* Reports directly to owner or General Manager

Essential duties and responsibilities include the following:

**PROSPECT DEVELOPMENT**

* Actively markets and performs cold calls to generate interest in our service lines.
* Is proficient in networking and diligently seeks and follows up on earned referrals.
* Actively promotes the brand and brand messaging on social media platforms.
* Works closely with Estimators and Project Managers to create estimates for various projects and opportunities.
* Present proposals to clients or prospect clients
* Tracks all activity in the CRM module of the company operating system
* Attend industry functions, such as association events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
* Present to and consult with mid and senior level management on business trends with a view to developing new services, products, and distribution channels.
* Identify opportunities for campaigns, services, and distribution channels that will lead to an increase in sales.
* Using knowledge of the market and competitors, identify and develop the company’s unique selling propositions and differentiators.

jobs.description:
We're hiring a part\-time Business Development \& Partnerships Coordinator to own and expand our partnership network. Your core focus will be managing our database of referral partners, real estate agents, and interior designers, conducting regular outreach, and sourcing new connections to generate high\-quality project leads.

This is a high\-impact role inside a fast\-moving company. If you are a proactive, warm, and polished relationship\-builder who can open doors, build trust quickly, and drive revenue growth without constant oversight, we'd like to meet you.

**What You'll Do**

* **Own the Network:** Maintain an organized understanding of our referral relationships, previous conversations, and next steps.
* **Active Outreach:** Conduct regular, structured outreach (via email, phone, and in\-person networking) to keep our brand top\-of\-mind and secure beneficial partnerships.
* **Proactive Prospecting:** Research and source new partnership opportunities through creative prospecting and your own industry connections to expand our pipeline.
* **Generate Project Leads:** Drive the partnership process from initial introduction to developing referral relationships through consistent follow\-up that results in steady project leads and increased revenue.
* **Track \& Report:** Keep accurate records of outreach activities and pipeline progress to share with the leadership team.

**What We're Looking For**

* **1–3 years of experience** in business development, sales, lead generation, or relationship management (experience working with real estate or design professionals is a major plus).
* **A warm, polished relationship\-builder** (rather than an aggressive or high\-volume salesperson) with exceptional communication skills who knows how to build trust and maintain long\-term professional relationships.
* **A self\-starter** who can maximize 15 hours a week effectively to deliver tangible, bottom\-line results.
* **Tech\-savvy** enough to easily navigate CRM tools, Google Workspace/Excel, and LinkedIn for research and tracking.

**Compensation:** $25/hour for approximately 15 hours per week, plus performance\-based bonuses

**Location:** Fully in\-office (Chicago, IL 60618\), with outside meetings and networking as needed

**Bonus Eligibility**

Performance\-based bonuses apply specifically when the employee's outreach generates a qualified lead for a specific residential remodeling project and the prospective customer completes a face\-to\-face meeting with our team. Meetings with architects, realtors, designers, or other potential referral partners are part of the regular position and do not qualify for a bonus on their own.

**How to Apply**

Please apply via email only. Applications submitted through Indeed or applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

Send an email to **customerservice@cobblestoneint.com** with the subject line "Cobblestone Business Development – \[Your Full Name]" including the following:

* Your resume as a PDF
* A description of your strongest sales, business\-development, or partnership win. In **150 words or less**, explain how you identified the opportunity, what you personally did, how you followed up, and what measurable result you produced.

Candidates selected for an interview will be asked to complete a free DISC personality profile beforehand.

Pay: $25\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

**Salary:** $50,000\-$60,000 per year

Join the AF Services Team

AF Services is a leading provider of event staffing, guest services, and event operations throughout the Chicagoland area. We partner with premier convention centers, trade shows, corporate events, sporting events, and special events to deliver exceptional service and operational excellence.

We're looking for an experienced, motivated leader to join our Operations team. This is a hands\-on management position for someone who thrives in fast\-paced environments, enjoys leading people, and takes pride in delivering outstanding service to clients.

**The majority of this role is spent managing live events onsite.** You'll oversee operations at some of the Midwest's largest convention and event venues, working directly with clients and leading teams to ensure every event is executed successfully.

When you're not onsite at events, you'll work from our **Oak Brook office** assisting with recruiting, scheduling, employee compliance, and operational planning.

If you enjoy the excitement of live events and no two days being the same, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll DoEvent Operations

· Serve as the onsite Event Operations Manager for conventions, trade shows, sporting events, and special events throughout the Chicagoland area.

· Manage event operations primarily at McCormick Place in Chicago and the Donald E. Stephens Convention Center in Rosemont, with additional assignments at other Chicagoland venues.

· Lead, supervise, and support large teams of event personnel before, during, and after events.

· Conduct pre\-event walkthroughs and coordinate logistics with clients, venue representatives, and internal staff.

· Serve as the primary onsite point of contact for clients.

· Resolve operational challenges quickly while maintaining a calm, professional approach.

· Complete post\-event reports and communicate operational updates to office leadership.

Team Leadership \& Operations

· Recruit, interview, and assist with hiring event staff.

· Assist with employee scheduling and workforce planning.

· Review employee PERC Card certifications and required compliance documentation.

· Coach and mentor employees.

· Summarize payroll following events and work with accounting to resolve payroll questions.

· Assist with client meetings and help build long\-term client relationships.

What We're Looking For

· Previous management or supervisory experience required.

· Experience in event operations, hospitality, security, customer service, or a related field preferred.

· Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

· Strong organizational and time management abilities.

· Ability to remain calm under pressure and make sound decisions.

· Comfortable supervising large teams.

· Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word.

· Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

Schedule

· Combination of office work in Oak Brook and onsite event management throughout the Chicagoland area.

Physical Requirements

· Ability to stand and walk for extended periods during events.

· Ability to navigate large convention centers and event venues.

· Ability to occasionally climb stairs and work indoors and outdoors as needed.

Benefits

· Health insurance

· Paid time off

· Illinois Secure Choice retirement program

· Professional development and leadership growth opportunities

· Opportunity to work at premier convention and event venues

Why AF Services?

At AF Services, you'll be trusted to make decisions, lead people, and represent our company with some of the region's most recognizable clients. If you're looking for a career where every day is different, your leadership matters, and your work directly contributes to the success of major events across Chicagoland, we encourage you to apply.

Bolingbrook, Illinois, United States of America
At Solina, our community of close to 5,000 people share a **passion for food** and live our entrepreneurial culture.


We design customised savoury solutions for our clients operating in the food industry, food service, butchery and nutrition markets. With **sustainability at the heart** of our business model, we aim to produce food that is good in every sense of the word: delicious, nourishing, affordable, sustainable and convenient.


Solina is a fast\-growing business, with around 50 production sites and R\&D laboratories present in more than 19 countries mainly in Europe and North America.


By constantly rethinking culinary solutions, **we make food matter for people and the planet** .  



If you're ready for a new adventure in a dynamic, expanding, passionate, international company, **join us** !


Solina USA is a proud Solina Group company, specializing in the creation of customized seasonings and sauces. With four strategically located production facilities across the United States, we deliver high‑quality, innovative flavor solutions efficiently and reliably. We serve Quick Service Restaurants, fast‑casual and casual‑dining chains, and food manufacturers, providing exceptional flavor solutions tailored to their unique needs. Solina USA has earned a strong national reputation for delivering an outstanding customer experience, offering high‑quality products at cost\-competitive price points. We build dynamic partnerships that allow our creativity to shine through our customers’ culinary vision — making “Food Matter.”

To support the growth of our U.S. business, we are seeking a motivated and results‑driven Sales Account Manager to manage and expand relationships with key customers while actively developing new business opportunities. This role will focus on promoting and selling customized seasonings and sauces that deliver exceptional flavor solutions.


The successful candidate will work closely with customers primarily in the snack and club segments, which represent key areas of business development, with potential involvement in industrial or QSR customers depending on business needs. The ideal candidate will have experience in food and beverage sales cycles, a strong understanding of customized solutions, and the ability to collaborate cross‑functionally to meet customer needs.


Reporting to the Director of Sales, Emerging Markets, this role will be instrumental in achieving sales targets and strengthening the company’s position as a trusted flavor solutions provider.

jobs.description:
The Habitat Company, LLC is a leader in residential multi\-family real estate management and development. We are looking for talented individuals to join our team as we continue to expand and develop our company nationwide. **Job Scope:**

The **Assistant Community Manager** is to assist the Community Manager in effectively managing the assigned community. In the Community Manager's absence, the Assistant Community Manager will assume all responsibilities associated with accomplishing community objectives as set forth by the Regional Manager and Property Ownership. In addition, the Assistant Community Manager is directly responsible for maintaining daily, weekly, and monthly reports including accurate reporting of rents and deposits received.


**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Greet residents either by phone or in person, in a professional and courteous manner, and in line with Habitat’s Core Values.
* Report any physical concerns to manager when walking the property.
* Process Account Payables weekly.
* Attend all trainings/meetings as directed by the Regional Manager, Community Manager, or Compliance Manager for further advancement of your skill level and information.
* Assist with training and developing other team members as needed.
* Assist with requests from Regional Office, as necessary.
* Assist with the preparations for Audits.
* Assist with correspondence to/from IHDA/HUD as needed.
* Meet with IHDA/HUD representatives during various audits and respond to findings, as needed.
* Generate and close work orders, as needed.
* Transmit the monthly HAP Voucher by the 10th of every month.
* Monitor the recertification process to ensure team members are working efficiently to complete all recertifications in a timely fashion.

* When meeting with residents, document their file with any concerns complaints that could become a future issue for the Management Office.

* Conduct all business in accordance with The Habitat Company policies and procedures, Fair Housing, Americans with Disabilities Act, and all other laws pertaining to property management.

* High school education or equivalent in work experience.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel).

* Optimize inventory flow and streamline operational processes while handling the accurate processing of shipments and transfers.

*

* Proficient in Microsoft Office, SAP, and other digital tools.
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong knowledge of operations and inventory control.
* Ability to lift and move objects up to 40 pounds.

What we offer


At Loro Piana, we believe in fostering a supportive and rewarding work environment that values our employees' well\-being and growth. We offer a comprehensive range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage, fertility support, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, 401K match, and Headspace mental health support. ***LORO PIANA***
**MAISON**
---------------------------

Originally from Trivero in northern Italy, the Loro Piana family began trading wool in the early 1800s. In 1924, Pietro Loro Piana founded Ing. Loro Piana \& C., the current company. **About Supermicro:**

Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. * Work with cross functional teams to draft and negotiate various types of contracts
* Manage day\-to\-day sales operations

• Ability to thrive both independently and in a team environment
  

• Demonstrated ability in the following areas: pre\-call planning, opportunity qualification and objection handling, call structure and control, time and territory management
  

• Strong persuasive and negotiating skills; Ability to polished words in verbal, written, and presentation

new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for a dynamic Strategic Account Manager to join our regional team. This person will be responsible for driving ResMed brand prescriptions and managing strong relationships with our company's key clients.


**The ideal candidate for this role would be located within a reasonable distance of San Francisco, California or San Francisco Bay Area area. Relocation assistance is not available.**

Key deliverables include planning, positioning and strategic marketing of ResMed solutions with referral sources, including but not limited to physicians, sleep labs and other. In addition, building rapport with clients to drive adoption of ResMed brand as clinical preference.


**Let’s talk about Responsibilities:**

* Drive durable ResMed brand prescriptions, identify referral opportunities, and increase patient funnel by leverage existing solutions
* Develop and maintain solid relationships and engagement with clients to drive ResMed branded prescriptions as direct clinical and operational preference
* Acquire a thorough understanding of client and patients’ needs to instill ResMed branded solutions from beginning to end of patient’s journey and to reduce fallout in the patient journey
* Shift client’s clinical preference from diagnosis basis to patient’s long\-term success
* Plan and execute strategies with specialists to drive client adoption of ResMed branded solutions
* Collaborate with support teams through sales process and long\-term implementation of solution(s) using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.
* Professionally represent ResMed as the subject matter expert on the broad portfolio of products and solutions.

**Let’s talk about Key Skills:**

* A data driven mindset to identify how to effectively increase customer funnel
* Ability to interpret key data/reports to clinically and constructively increasing shares
* Analyze client data to understand patient and provider relationship to offer ResMed brand solutions
* The ability to develop a strong business acumen, build trust and creditability with client and gain their adoption to ResMed solutions and products as primary preference
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build rapport with clients and adjust strategy to meet their needs

**Qualifications and Experience:**

**Required**

* 5\+ years of sales experience plus a bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* Prior top ranked medical device, business to business (B2B) or business to consumer (B2C)
* Exceptional sales, negotiating and closing skills
* Experience using Salesforce (SFDC) or similar customer relationship management (CRM) platform.
* Excellence in all forms of communication, effective communicator in upstream and cross channel collaboration
* Motivated, execution and results focus with accountability for continuous improvement.
* Team player with strong work ethic and a can\-do attitude.
* Ability to travel throughout territory as necessary to achieve results

**Why Resmed?**

**Impact at Scale:** Help shape solutions used by millions worldwide.
  

**Global Reach:** Work across regions, teams, and technologies in a truly interconnected ecosystem.
  

**Career Growth:** Thrive in a dynamic, inclusive environment where bold ideas are welcomed.
  

**Purpose\-Driven Work:** Join a company committed to improving lives—one breath, one night, one patient at a time.


**Join Us!**

At Resmed, we believe innovation starts with people. We value diversity of thought, agility, and imagination — and we know that building something meaningful takes leaders who are passionate, humble, and technically sharp.


We are shaping the future at Resmed, and we recognize the need to build on and broaden our existing skills and continue to attract and retain the world’s best talent. We work hard to offer holistic benefits packages, provide flexible work arrangements, cultivate a workforce culture that allows employees to grow personally and professionally, and deliver competitive salaries to our team members. Employees scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week are eligible for benefits. This position qualifies for the following benefits package: comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and life, AD\&D, short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, sleep care management, Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), commuter benefits, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and tuition assistance. Employees have Flexible Time Off (FTO), receive 11 paid holidays plus 3 floating days and are eligible for 14 weeks of primary caregiver or two weeks of secondary caregiver leave when welcoming new family members.


Individual pay decisions are based on a variety of factors, such as the candidate’s geographic work location, relevant qualifications, work experience, and skills.


At Resmed, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current base range for this position is: $90,000\.00 USD Annual \+ TIC.


Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

new_jobs.title: Business Sales Representative – Territory Accounts
new_jobs.description:
**Exciting opportunity to be eligible for a $5,500 bonus when you join our team.**


As a **Business Sales Representative – Territory Accounts**, you will own a defined local geography and focus on creating new business with small and mid\-sized companies. This is an acquisition sales role built for a motivated outside seller who is comfortable with various prospecting strategies including cold calling and walking into businesses to set appointments that will then be used to work with the customer to identify their challenges and create solutions to solve your customer’s problems. You will spend most of your time in the market identifying these opportunities, meeting business owners and decision\-makers, and positioning the right AT\&T solutions.

**Earn with confidence and upside.** This role offers a competitive base salary as well as performance\-based commissions tied directly to your sales results. At 100% of target, **annual earnings range from** **$96,800 to $154,100**. Earnings ramp as you build your customer opportunities, develop new customer relationships, and consistently close new business. Your income is directly correlated to your activity, execution, quota performance, and the strength of your sales pipeline.

**What you’ll do day to day:**

* **Balance field and office collaboration:** Sales employees will concentrate on acquiring new business and conducting customer meetings most often, at the customer location. When not in the field, sales employees are expected to collaborate with their team from their assigned office location and place of work.
* **Prospect for new logos:** Identify and pursue new business through customer prospect lists that will be provided and will enable the seller to cold call door knock, and email. The seller will also be able to leverage in\-person customer meetings, work referrals, networking, and local market research.
* **Set appointments and create a pipeline:** Build a consistent approach of customer outreach, qualify prospects, schedule customer meetings, and advance opportunities through the sales process.
* **Own your territory:** Manage a defined geographic territory, prioritize target accounts, understand local business needs, and execute a market plan that supports consistent quota attainment.
* **Sell a broad business portfolio:** Position AT\&T solutions across wireless, fiber, internet, voice, software defined networking and cybersecurity.
* **Serve multiple customer segments:** Engage small and mid\-sized businesses across vertical industries such as retail, professional services, healthcare, construction, logistics, hospitality, and local multi\-site operators.
* **Manage the full sales cycle:** Move opportunities from prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation, close, implementation handoff, and follow\-up.
* **Maintain disciplined CRM activity:** Record calls, visits, appointments, opportunities, next steps, and forecast updates accurately and consistently.

**What you’ll bring:**

* 2–5 years of quota carrying outside acquisition sales experience is ideal.
* Demonstrated success acquiring new business sales through prospecting, cold calling, referrals, appointment setting, and disciplined follow\-up with both customers and in Salesforce.
* Comfort spending significant time in the field visiting businesses, initiating conversations, and building relationships with owners, operators, and decision\-makers.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to uncover customer needs and connect them to AT\&T’s product and solution portfolio.
* Confidence handling objections, negotiating, asking for the sale, and advancing opportunities toward close.
* Self\-disciplined work style and the ability to manage daily activity, Salesforce updates, pipeline health, and quota expectations.
* Ability to collaborate with the team from the assigned office location, if available, when not acquiring new business or conducting customer visits in the field.
* Valid driver’s license, satisfactory driving record, current auto insurance, and reliable transportation to support field\-based selling.


Selling for AT\&T means bringing a recognized brand, broad product portfolio, and established business reputation into every customer conversation. You will receive paid training, sales support, coaching, and access to tools that help you build pipeline and grow your book of business. For sellers who consistently perform, this role creates a path into larger territories, advanced sales roles, account management, leadership opportunities, and long\-term career across AT\&T.

**Ready to close the deal on a career with AT\&T?**


Apply today.


\#MidMarketSales


Our Specialist Sales Exec S1\-Territory Fib jobs earn between $51,800\.00 \- $77,600\.00 \+ commission $45,000 . Not to mention all the other amazing rewards that working at AT\&T offers. Individual starting salary within this range may depend on geography, experience, expertise, and education/training.
**Joining our team comes with amazing perks and benefits:**

  

* Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Tuition reimbursement program
* Paid Time Off and Holidays (based on data of hire, at least 23 days of vacation each year and 9 company designated holidays)
* Paid Parental Leave
* Paid Caregiver Leave
* Additional sick leave beyond what state and local law require may be available but is unprotected
* Adoption Reimbursement
* Disability Benefits (short term and long term)
* Life and Accidental Death Insurance
* Supplemental benefit programs: critical illness/accident hospital indemnity/group legal

Ability to be seated for long periods of time.

This role is required to work 35\-40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

This position is full\-time, non\-exempt with a salary of $75,254 and includes full benefits (medical, dental, vision, life insurance, long\-term disability, incentive savings plan, paid time off, Public Service Loan Forgiveness, and potential for parental leave for full\-time regular employees who have been employed with GrowNYC for 175 day

new_jobs.title: Loro Piana, Seasonal Operations Specialist, Madison Avenue
new_jobs.description:
### **Position**

Loro Piana is an Italian luxury Maison founded in 1924, known for creating the finest quality textiles, ready\-to\-wear collections, accessories, and bespoke garments. Our dedication to exceptional craftsmanship and use of the world’s finest raw materials positions us a leader in the luxury industry. As an iconic Maison within the LVMH group, we uphold a strong commitment to unparalleled quality and excellence.  



General Purpose of the Position:


We are seeking a Seasonal Operations Specialist to join our team at Loro Piana. The Operations Specialist plays a pivotal role in the overall success of the business by supporting all operational and inventory\-related activities. You will be responsible for managing incoming and outgoing shipments, replenishing products on the sales floor, and organizing inventory to maximize efficiency. You will collaborate with all members of the team to ensure that stockroom conditions align with Loro Piana standards, contributing to seamless store operations.


### **Job responsibilities**

Key Responsibilities


* Optimize inventory flow and streamline operational processes while handling the accurate processing of shipments and transfers.
* Oversee the movement of merchandise from the stockroom to the sales floor and maintain appropriate inventory levels to align with sales potential.
* Conduct cycle counts as per corporate calendar to verify product quantities and report discrepancies in a timely manner. Perform regular audits to verify product conditions.
* Facilitate the implementation of security measures through inspections, audits, and preparing products for display.
* Ensure ongoing inventory organization according to company procedures and establish an optimized warehouse layout for improved accessibility by the sales team.
* Maintain clean, neat, and organized stock rooms with proper labeling to facilitate sales.
* Maintain effective communication with the operations team and external couriers to ensure accurate shipping procedures and timely delivery.
Provide the sales team with detailed updates regarding inventory availability to support the sales process and enhance sales performance.  
* 
### **Profile**

Skills and Abilities Required


* 3\+ years of operational and inventory experience, preferably in a luxury retail environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, SAP, and other digital tools.
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong knowledge of operations and inventory control.
* Ability to lift and move objects up to 40 pounds.
### **Additional information**

What we offer


At Loro Piana, we believe in fostering a supportive and rewarding work environment that values our employees' well\-being and growth. We offer a comprehensive range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage, fertility support, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, 401K match, and Headspace mental health support. Additionally, employees enjoy a generous product discount, exclusive LVMH discounts, and other tailored perks.


Compensation


Loro Piana uses the published salary range as a guideline to provide our employees with market\-competitive pay while allowing for flexibility to recognize and reward various levels of expertise, performance, and tenure.
  

  

While the published salary range is a good faith reflection of the targeted salary level for the position, Loro Piana reserves the right to pay outside of the published salary range of $24 to $26 USD per hour.
  

  

EEO Statement


We strive to create a culture of inclusion where everyone has a sense of belonging. Our goal is to ensure that our outreach and recruiting efforts generate diverse identities and perspectives that will be valued and can thrive. We are continuously assessing our employee and candidate populations to identify ways to ensure they are all\-encompassing and equitable.


***LORO PIANA***
**MAISON**
---------------------------

Originally from Trivero in northern Italy, the Loro Piana family began trading wool in the early 1800s. In 1924, Pietro Loro Piana founded Ing. Loro Piana \& C., the current company. Pietro’s nephew Franco took over in 1941, and after the war the firm began to establish its reputation as a supplier of premium wool and cashmere textiles for a growing haute couture industry, both home and abroad. In the 1970s, Sergio and Pier Luigi Loro Piana took up the reins, diversifying into luxury goods and developing an international retail arm. Now the world’s foremost cashmere processor, Loro Piana prides itself on sourcing the very finest, rarest raw materials the world has to offer, including unique cashmere from baby goats in northern China and Mongolia, vicuña from the Andes, extra\-fine Merino wool from Australia and New Zealand and lotus flower fiber from Myanmar. The company draws on both time\-honored traditions and state of the art technology to offer its discerning customers products that are renowned for their peerless quality. All of the company’s collections of ready\-to\-wear garments and accessories are made in Italy to the highest standards of craftsmanship and sartorial excellence.

new_jobs.title: Medicare Sales Representative II
new_jobs.description:
**About NYC Health \+ Hospitals**
---------------------------------

  


MetroPlus**Health** provides the highest quality healthcare services to residents of Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens and Staten Island through a comprehensive list of products, including, but not limited to, New York State Medicaid Managed Care, Medicare, Child Health Plus, Exchange, Partnership in Care, MetroPlus Gold, Essential Plan, etc. As a wholly\-owned subsidiary of NYC Health \+ Hospitals, the largest public health system in the United States, MetroPlus**Health**'s network includes over 27,000 primary care providers, specialists and participating clinics. For more than 40 years, MetroPlus**Health** has been committed to building strong relationships with its members and providers.


Purpose of Position:  

Under varying degrees of supervision, identifies qualified Medicare participants and educates them as to the benefits of selecting MetroPlus as a managed care provider. Achieves predetermined monthly enrollments based on regularly updated goals and objectives, documents consumer contracts, and processes grievances. Moreover, maintains a positive public relations presence within the community, provider agencies, and with city and state regulatory agencies. Additionally, may provide training of and/or supervision to subordinate staff. There are three Assignment Levels  

within this class of positions; all personnel perform related work.


**Work Shifts**
---------------

  


**9:00 A.M – 5:00 P.M**

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**
------------------------------

  


Level I  

Under supervision, performs the following typical tasks:  

  

1\. Implements methods, activities and action plans necessary to achieve daily, weekly and monthly objectives.  

2\. Presents clear and accurate information regarding health plan to eligible recipients and community\-at\-large.  

3\. Performs group and individual presentations for purpose of educating and enrolling qualified participants in a variety of arenas including but not limited to senior centers, provider sites,  

churches, assisted living facilities, nursing homes, etc.  

4\. Provides all benefit/service related information to members, applicants, and providers.  

5\. Performs telemarketing activities as appropriate for purposes of enrollment and follow\-up activity.  

6\. Processes all member demographic changes.  

7\. Maintains accurate documentation related to enrollment and field activities.  

8\. Participates in regularly scheduled sales/marketing meetings as required.  

9\. Performs other related tasks as directed.

  

Level II  

Under supervision, with latitude for independent judgment and decision making, performs the work of Assignment Level I at a higher level, and/or the following typical tasks:  

  

1\. May act as preceptor to subordinate Enrollment Sales Representatives to facilitate their understanding of MetroPlus objectives, operations and site specific information.  

2\. Implements and monitors appropriate methods, activities and action plans necessary to regularly achieve accelerated predetermined enrollment objectives.  

3\. Ensures appropriate and accurate documentation of call center plan enrollments and field activities.  

4\. Provides assistance and facilitates communications to sales/customer services management team.  

5\. Participates in bi\-weekly and monthly sales/marketing meetings.  

6\. Performs related duties as directed.


**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  


1\. Possession of a valid Life/Accident / Health Insurance Agent License issued by the  

New York State Insurance Department; and  

2\. Possession of a High School diploma or evidence of having satisfactorily passed a  

High School Equivalency Program; and,  

3\. Satisfactory completion of training and orientation administered by MHP personnel;  

and,  

4\. One year of experience in direct consumer contact, sales and/or social services; or,  

5\. A satisfactory equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.  

However, all incumbents must possess the required licensure as described in one  

above.  

6\. Knowledge of a second language may be required.  

  

For appointment to Level II:  

1\. One year of experience in Assignment Level I or one additional year of experience as  

described above.  

  

For appointment to Level III:  

1\. One year of experience in Assignment Level II or two additional years of experience  

as described above.  

  

Special Notes:  

Possession of a valid Life/Accident / Health Insurance Agent License issued by the  

New York State Insurance Department must be maintained in order to remain in this  

position. Possession of a valid New York State Drivers License may be required.  

The use of this position is restricted to MetroPlus only.


**Benefits**
------------

  


NYC Health and Hospitals offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

* Comprehensive Health Benefits for employees hired to work 20\+ hrs. per week
* Retirement Savings and Pension Plans
* Paid Holidays and Vacation in accordance with employees' Collectively bargained contracts
* Loan Forgiveness Programs for eligible employees
* College tuition discounts and professional development opportunities
* College Savings Program
* Union Benefits for eligible titles
* Multiple employee discounts programs
* Commuter Benefits Programs


**How To Apply**
----------------

  


If you wish to apply for this position, please apply online by clicking the "Apply for Job" button.

Our Executive Assistants are highly\-respected because their skills are quite simply, essential. You’d be a key member of a dynamic, fast\-paced team that serves as a center of excellence for the enterprise, partnering with leadership across lines of business. “EQ” skills to build bridges, forge alliances and encourage people to want to work with you.

* Plan and execute high profile events, including quarterly earnings calls and investor meetings

**Work Experience:**

* At least 3 years supporting a Vice President or higher\-level executive.
* At least 3 years supporting multiple executives, preferably in different departments

* Solid written and verbal communication skills, including strong grammar and a rich vocabulary
* Ability to multi\-task and prioritize deadlines/deliverables.

This is PowerPlan's first Business Development Representative role — a high\-visibility seat built to solve one of the company's most pressing go\-to\-market challenges: building predictable top\-of\-funnel pipeline in a new\-market sales motion. You'll be the engine behind outbound prospecting into asset\-intensive enterprises, opening conversations with senior finance and IT leaders, qualifying opportunities, and booking discovery calls that free our Strategic Account Executives to focus on closing.  

This role comes with a defined career progression path mapped out at approximately the 18\-month mark, a full sales tech stack on day one, and finalized ICP and buyer personas before you start. It's the right seat for someone early in their sales career who wants to learn enterprise software sales from the inside, build a foundation in a complex B2B market, and grow into a closing role.
Responsibilities:

Success will be measured by how fast you ramp to full outbound activity, how consistently you hit your outreach targets, and by the quality — not just the volume — of the meetings you hand off to Strategic AEs.* Complete structured onboarding and earn messaging certification within your first 60 days, ramping to full outbound activity targets.
* Execute a high\-volume, multi\-channel outbound motion — cold calling, cold email, and LinkedIn\-led social selling — targeting buying committees within PowerPlan's ideal customer profile.

**PROJECT COORDINATOR – ASSET RECOVERY**

**Employment Type: Full\-Time****Work Arrangement: Hybrid – Office / Remote****Reports To: Asset Recovery Leadership****Position Summary**


The Project Coordinator – Asset Recovery is responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, execution, and documentation of asset recovery and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) projects.


This position serves as a central point of coordination between customers, operations, transportation providers, warehouse teams, project managers, sales, and other internal resources to ensure projects are executed accurately, securely, on schedule, and in accordance with established customer requirements.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously, and able to communicate effectively in a fast\-paced logistics environment. Because Asset Recovery projects frequently involve sensitive technology assets, customer data, serial\-number tracking, chain\-of\-custody requirements, and multiple service partners, attention to detail and documentation are critical to success.


This is a hybrid position requiring regular presence in the office, combined with the flexibility to work remotely based on business needs and the established hybrid schedule.

* Coordinate Asset Recovery projects from initial project setup through final completion and closeout.
* Review project scope, customer requirements, schedules, locations, equipment quantities, transportation requirements, and special handling instructions.
* Create and maintain project schedules, task lists, project documentation, and internal communication.
* Coordinate project activities with internal operations teams, transportation providers, warehouses, field crews, technicians, recycling partners, and other service providers.
* Confirm resources, equipment, transportation, labor, and site requirements prior to scheduled project activity.
* Track project milestones and proactively identify scheduling conflicts, missing information, or potential service issues.

* Ensure required documentation is collected and maintained throughout each project.
* Assist with tracking serial numbers, asset tags, quantities, pallet counts, shipment information, and final disposition records.
* Maintain accurate chain\-of\-custody documentation from customer location through transportation, processing, disposition, recycling, resale, or other approved destination.
* Identify discrepancies between expected and actual asset quantities and escalate exceptions promptly.
* Support reconciliation of project records and final asset reporting.**Logistics \& Transportation Coordination**
* Schedule and coordinate transportation required for Asset Recovery projects.
* Confirm vehicle requirements, pickup and delivery appointments, site restrictions, loading requirements, and special handling needs.
* Communicate shipment requirements to transportation partners and field operations.
* Track shipments and project activity through completion.
* Assist with resolving delays, missed appointments, damaged assets, documentation discrepancies, or other transportation exceptions.
* Coordinate multiple locations and shipments when projects involve regional or national deployments.**Documentation \& Compliance**
* Maintain complete and accurate electronic project files.
* Ensure required documentation is received, including bills of lading, chain\-of\-custody records, asset inventories, photographs, manifests, certificates, and other project\-specific documentation.
* Follow established Asset Recovery procedures related to information security, data\-bearing equipment, customer confidentiality, and asset handling.

* Maintain confidentiality regarding customer information, technology assets, and sensitive project information.**Financial \& Administrative Support**
